MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

vision-language-action model temporal modeling memory bank world model robotic manipulation

简要说明：MemoryVLA++通过整合工作记忆、基于感知-认知记忆库的 episodic 记忆以及用于想象的世界模型，增强了VLA模型在机器人操作中的能力，在仿真和真实机器人上的长时域和依赖时间的任务中取得了显著提升。

TLDR: MemoryVLA++ enhances VLA models for robotic manipulation by integrating working memory, episodic memory via a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank, and a world model for imagination, achieving significant gains on long-horizon and temporally dependent tasks across simulation and real robots.

Abstract: Temporal modeling is essential for robotic manipulation, as effective control requires both memory of past interactions and imagination of future states. However, most VLA models rely primarily on the current observation and therefore struggle with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Cognitive science suggests that humans rely on working memory to buffer short-lived context, the hippocampal system to preserve episodic memory of past experience, and internal models to imagine possible future state evolution. Inspired by these mechanisms, we propose MemoryVLA++, a full temporal modeling framework that equips VLA models with memory and imagination for robotic manipulation. A pretrained VLM encodes the current observation into perceptual and cognitive tokens, forming working memory. These tokens query a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank to retrieve relevant historical context. This bank stores low-level details and high-level semantics from past interactions, and is updated through redundancy-aware consolidation. A world model imagines future states in a denoising latent space, and the imagined latents are integrated under memory guidance to form full temporal-aware tokens. The resulting tokens condition a diffusion action expert to predict temporally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on 5 simulation benchmarks and 3 categories of real-robot tasks across 3 robots, covering general manipulation, long-horizon temporal tasks, robustness, and generalization. Our method achieves strong performance across Libero, SimplerEnv, Mikasa-Robo, Calvin, Libero-Plus, and diverse real-robot tasks, validating the effectiveness of full temporal modeling with memory and imagination. For example, on real robots, it achieves +9%, +26%, +28% gains on general, memory-dependent, and imagination-dependent tasks. Project Page: https://shihao1895.github.io/MemoryVLA-PP-Web

摘要（中文）：时间建模对于机器人操作至关重要，因为有效控制既需要对过去交互的记忆，也需要对未来状态的想象。然而，大多数VLA模型主要依赖当前观测，因此在处理长时域、时间依赖性任务时存在困难。认知科学表明，人类依赖工作记忆缓冲短期情境，依赖海马系统保存过往经验的 episodic 记忆，并依赖内部模型想象未来可能的状态演化。受这些机制启发，我们提出 MemoryVLA++，一个完整的时间建模框架，为 VLA 模型赋予记忆与想象能力以支持机器人操作。预训练 VLM 将当前观测编码为感知与认知 token，构成工作记忆；这些 token 查询感知-认知记忆库以检索相关历史情境。该记忆库存储来自过去交互的低层细节与高层语义，并通过冗余感知的整合机制进行更新。一个世界模型在去噪潜在空间中想象未来状态，并在记忆引导下整合这些想象潜在表征，形成完整的时间感知 token。最终 token 条件化一个扩散动作专家，使其预测时间一致的动作序列。我们在 5 个仿真基准、3 类真实机器人任务（涵盖 3 种机器人）上开展了广泛实验，覆盖通用操作、长时域时间任务、鲁棒性与泛化能力。我们的方法在 Libero、SimplerEnv、Mikasa-Robo、Calvin、Libero-Plus 以及多种真实机器人任务上均取得了优异性能，验证了融合记忆与想象的完整时间建模的有效性。例如，在真实机器人上，该方法在通用任务、记忆依赖任务及想象依赖任务上分别取得了 +9%、+26% 和 +28% 的性能提升。项目页面：https://shihao1895.github.io/MemoryVLA-PP-Web

Authors: Hao Shi, Weiye Li, Bin Xie, Yulin Wang, Renping Zhou, Tiancai Wang, Xiangyu Zhang, Ping Luo, Gao Huang

Video2Sim2Real: Full-Stack Autonomous Dexterous Skill Acquisition from a Single Human Video Manipulation

dexterous manipulation sim-to-real human video digital twin residual RL

简要说明：一个全栈框架，从单段人类操作视频中提取灵巧操作技能，通过重建数字孪生、以物体为中心的关键帧优化机器人运动，并利用模仿学习和残差强化学习弥合仿真到现实的差距。

TLDR: A full-stack framework that extracts dexterous manipulation skills from a single human video by reconstructing a digital twin, optimizing robot motion through object-centric keyframes, and bridging the sim-to-real gap with imitation learning and residual reinforcement learning.

Abstract: Human manipulation videos are a convenient and intuitive source for robot learning. However, directly transferring human dexterity to robots remains challenging due to perception errors and embodiment gap. To address this, we introduce Video2Sim2Real, a full-stack framework for autonomous skill acquisition from a single human manipulation video. Our framework first uses off-the-shelf foundation models to reconstruct a simulator-ready digital twin and extract robot and object motion priors. Rather than treating the extracted robot motion as a reliable reference throughout execution, our key idea is to recover and leverage the most fundamental sources of supervision from the demonstrated skill: We identify object-centric keyframes to optimize the corresponding robot configurations using object information from the simulator, and use these configurations as anchors that refine the robot motion such that it ultimately has the desired impact on the environment. To bridge the remaining sim-to-real gap, we introduce a sim-to-real strategy that decouples robustness to noisy and incomplete perception from variations in hand-object interaction dynamics. Specifically, we learn to recalibrate robot configurations from noisy real-world point clouds via IL, and leverage residual RL to perform local finger-level adaptations to ensure for robust and effective interactions. Finally, a collision-aware motion planning module enables spatial generalization to novel object configurations. Across several everyday manipulation tasks, Video2Sim2Real improves simulated task success, safety, and trajectory coherence over numerous baselines, and achieves better sim-to-real transfer than existing techniques. These results demonstrate a promising path toward autonomous dexterous skill acquisition from human videos.

摘要（中文）：人类操作视频是机器人学习便捷且直观的来源。然而，由于感知误差与具身差异，直接将人类灵巧性迁移至机器人仍具挑战。为应对这一问题，我们提出Video2Sim2Real——一个从单段人类操作视频中自主获取技能的全栈框架。该框架首先利用现成的基础模型重建可直接用于仿真的数字孪生体，并提取机器人与物体的运动先验。与将提取的机器人运动作为全程可靠参考不同，我们的核心思路是从演示技能中恢复并利用最根本的监督源：通过识别以物体为中心的关键帧，利用仿真中的物体信息优化对应的机器人构型，并将这些构型作为锚点来优化机器人运动，使其最终对环境产生预期影响。为弥合剩余仿真到现实的差距，我们提出一种解耦策略，将噪声与不完整感知的鲁棒性从手-物交互动态变化中分离：具体而言，通过模仿学习从真实世界的含噪点云中重新校准机器人构型，并利用残差强化学习执行局部手指级自适应，确保鲁棒有效的交互。最终，碰撞感知的运动规划模块实现了对新型物体构型的空间泛化能力。在多项日常操作任务中，Video2Sim2Real相比众多基线方法提升了仿真任务成功率、安全性与轨迹连贯性，且实现了优于现有技术的仿真到现实迁移效果。这些成果为从人类视频自主获取灵巧技能开辟了可行路径。

Authors: Yunhai Han, Jianuo Qiu, Linhao Bai, Ziyu Xiao, Zihang Zeng, Yangcen Liu, Zhaodong Yang, Shalin Jain, Wenrui Ma, Jiaqi Fu, Yuqian Zheng, Manisha Natarajan, Muhammad Zubair Irshad, Kenneth Shaw, Matthew Gombolay, Zsolt Kira, Harish Ravichandar

RGB-S: Image-Aligned Tactile Saliency for Robust Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

visuo-tactile integration dexterous manipulation tactile saliency occlusion robustness force-modulated Gaussian maps

简要说明：通过校准的运动学将触觉传感器数据显式投影到RGB图像平面，生成力调制显著性图，将物理接触先验注入视觉主干网络，在遮挡下显著提升灵巧操作成功率。

TLDR: Explicitly projects tactile sensor data onto the RGB image plane via calibrated kinematics, creating force-modulated saliency maps that inject physical contact priors into visual backbones, significantly improving dexterous manipulation under occlusion.

Abstract: Effective visuo-tactile integration is critical for robotic dexterous manipulation, especially when visual observations are unreliable or occluded. However, robustly aligning sparse, heterogeneous tactile measurements with dense visual representations remains a fundamental challenge. Most existing approaches require policies to learn cross-modal correspondences implicitly from limited demonstrations, without leveraging geometric priors. As a result, they are often data-inefficient and generalize poorly when visual observations are degraded. To address this limitation, we propose a framework that explicitly grounds physical contacts in the image domain. Using robot forward kinematics and camera calibration, we project tactile sensor locations directly onto the RGB image plane. We then render force-modulated Gaussian saliency maps to model spatial uncertainty arising from kinematic and calibration errors. By integrating these 2D spatial anchors through a zero-initialized conditioning architecture, our method injects physical contact priors into standard visual backbones while preserving pre-trained visual representations. We evaluate our method on six dexterous manipulation tasks in both simulation and the real world under severe visual occlusions. Real-world experiments show that explicit RGB-S grounding in the image domain improves real-world occluded manipulation success rates by $26.7$ percentage points over the strongest implicit visuo-tactile baseline, suggesting its improved spatial reasoning and robustness to occlusion. Project page: touch-as-saliency.github.io

摘要（中文）：有效的视觉-触觉融合对于机器人灵巧操作至关重要，尤其是在视觉观测不可靠或存在遮挡的情况下。然而，将稀疏、异质的触觉测量与稠密的视觉表征进行稳健对齐仍是一项根本性挑战。现有方法大多要求策略从有限的示范中隐式学习跨模态对应关系，而未利用几何先验。因此，当视觉观测降质时，这些方法通常数据利用率低且泛化能力差。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种框架，显式将物理接触锚定在图像域中。利用机器人正向运动学与相机标定，将触觉传感器位置直接投影至RGB图像平面，并渲染力调制的高斯显著性图以建模运动学及标定误差引起的空间不确定性。通过零初始化的条件调节架构整合这些二维空间锚点，我们的方法在保留预训练视觉表征的同时，将物理接触先验注入标准视觉主干网络。我们在严重视觉遮挡条件下的仿真与真实世界中，对六项灵巧操作任务进行了评估。真实实验表明，在图像域中显式进行RGB-空间锚定（RGB-S）可将真实世界遮挡操作成功率较最强的隐式视觉-触觉基线提升26.7个百分点，证实了该方法在空间推理及对遮挡的鲁棒性方面的改进。项目页面：touch-as-saliency.github.io

Authors: Shengcheng Luo, Kefei Wu, Xiaoying Zhou, Wanlin Li, Ziyuan Jiao, Chenxi Xiao

Scaling by Diversified Experience for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action model Intent Decoupling robotic policy reinforcement learning out-of-distribution generalization

简要说明：SyVLA 提出了一种 VLA 模型，通过意图解耦分离控制与推理，并利用相似样本引导的强化学习管道稳定训练，在真实机器人任务上实现了更高的任务成功率和泛化能力。

TLDR: SyVLA introduces a VLA model with Intention Decoupling to isolate control from reasoning and a similar-sample-guided RL pipeline to stabilize training, achieving superior task success and generalization on real robots.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models face significant challenges in real-world deployment due to the entanglement of high-level reasoning with low-level control, and the instability of policy optimization. In this paper, we introduce SyVLA, a robust VLA model trained with diversified experiences. We propose an Intention Decoupling algorithm to isolate control-relevant features from reasoning contexts and a similar-sample guided RL pipeline to stabilize policy updates and mitigate distribution shift. Extensive experiments on real-world robotic tasks and multi-modal benchmarks demonstrate that SyVLA achieves superior task success rates and stronger out-of-distribution generalization compared to existing methods, while effectively preserving core vision-language capabilities. Codes and Datasets is released on \href{https://sy-vla.github.io/}{project page}.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型在实际部署中面临显著挑战，主要源于高层推理与底层控制的相互纠缠以及策略优化的不稳定性。本文提出SyVLA，一种基于多样化经验训练的鲁棒VLA模型。我们设计了一种意图解耦算法，用于从推理上下文中分离与控制相关的特征，并构建了基于相似样本引导的强化学习流水线，以稳定策略更新并缓解分布偏移。在真实机器人任务及多模态基准上的大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，SyVLA实现了更高的任务成功率和更强的分布外泛化能力，同时有效保留了核心视觉-语言能力。代码与数据集已在项目页面中发布。

Authors: Leiyu Wang, Zhaofengnian Wang, Xueqi Li, Luoyi Fan, Cewu Lu, Nanyang Ye

iMaC: Translating Actions into Motion and Contact Images for Embodied World Models WorldModel

image as action embodied world models visual manipulation image-action encoder dynamic world predictor

简要说明：iMaC提出了一种将原始图像作为动作表示（图像动作标记）的范式，用于具身世界模型，取代低维动作向量，以提升在操作任务中的表现力、泛化能力和物理动态建模。

TLDR: iMaC proposes a paradigm that uses raw images as action representations (image-action tokens) for embodied world models, replacing low-dimensional action vectors to improve expressiveness, generalization, and physical dynamic modeling in manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a pivotal paradigm for visual robotic decision-making and interactive environment simulation. However, conventional embodied frameworks rely on low-dimensional structured action vectors (e.g., joint angles and end-effector poses), which suffer from limited expressive capacity, poor generalization across diverse embodiments, and unnatural dynamic modeling for complex physical interactions. To address these limitations, this paper proposesiMac (Image as Action Control), a novel unified control paradigm that treats raw visual images as native action representations for embodied world models. Departing from traditional explicit kinematic action encoding, iMac formulates continuous visual manipulation as image-based action tokens, which inherently encapsulate spatial motion intentions, interactive geometric constraints and subtle physical dynamics. We construct a dual-branch embodied architecture consisting of an image-action encoder and a dynamic world predictor: the encoder compresses target-driven visual images into compact action embeddings, while the predictor learns environment transition rules conditioned on image actions to achieve high-fidelity future state prediction and closed-loop embodied control. Extensive experiments are conducted on public embodied manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic scenarios. The results demonstrate that iMac outperforms vector-based action control baselines in prediction accuracy, task success rate and cross-scene generalization ability. Moreover, our image-action design eliminates the reliance on manually defined action spaces, realizing flexible and universal control for heterogeneous embodied agents. This work provides an innovative visual-action perspective for embodied world models, offering a simple yet effective paradigm for scalable robotic perception and manipulation.

摘要（中文）：具身世界模型已成为视觉机器人决策与交互环境模拟的关键范式。然而，传统具身框架依赖低维结构化动作向量（如关节角度与末端执行器位姿），存在表达能力有限、跨不同具身形态泛化能力差、复杂物理交互动态建模不自然等问题。为解决上述局限，本文提出iMac（以图像作为动作控制）——一种将原始视觉图像作为具身世界模型原生动作表征的新型统一控制范式。不同于传统显式运动学动作编码，iMac将连续视觉操控定义为基于图像的动作标记，其本质封装了空间运动意图、交互几何约束与细微物理动态。我们构建了由图像动作编码器与动态世界预测器组成的双分支具身架构：编码器将目标驱动的视觉图像压缩为紧凑动作嵌入，预测器则学习以图像动作为条件的环境转换规则，实现高保真未来状态预测与闭环具身控制。在公开具身操控基准与真实机器人场景中开展的广泛实验表明，iMac在预测精度、任务成功率与跨场景泛化能力上均优于基于向量的动作控制基线。此外，我们的图像动作设计消除了对手动定义动作空间的依赖，实现了异构具身智能体的灵活通用控制。本工作为具身世界模型提供了创新视觉动作视角，为可扩展的机器人感知与操控提供了简洁而有效的范式。

Authors: Zhenyu Wu, Xiuwei Xu, Yukun Zhou, Yifan Li, Qiuping Deng, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Bingyao Yu, Ziwei Wang, Jiwen Lu, Haibin Yan

AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing Manipulation

world-action model dual Diffusion Transformer asynchronous temporal resolution horizon-adaptive offset training Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing

简要说明：AHA-WAM提出了一种异步双DiT架构用于机器人操作，低频视频DiT建模长时域世界演化，高频动作DiT通过观测引导的上下文路由实现实时控制，在RoboTwin和真实任务上达到SOTA成功率并实现24.17 Hz的闭环速度。

TLDR: AHA-WAM introduces an asynchronous dual-DiT architecture for robot manipulation, where a low-frequency video DiT models long-horizon world evolution and a high-frequency action DiT executes real-time control via observation-guided context routing, achieving state-of-the-art success rates and 24.17 Hz closed-loop speed.

Abstract: World-action models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation, jointly modeling visual scene dynamics and actions to inject physical priors into policy learning. However, existing world-action models couple world prediction and action execution at the same temporal resolution, forcing the world branch to model near-term frame variations that are redundant and weakly informative. We posit that strictly binding world prediction and action execution to the same temporal rhythm may underutilize the potential of the video branch for embodied control. Therefore, we propose AHA-WAM, an Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Model built on a dual Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that reorganizes world-action modeling around this temporal asymmetry. AHA-WAM instantiates the video DiT as a low-frequency world planner that maintains rolling key-value memory over past observations and exposes reusable layerwise latent context encoding long-horizon scene evolution, while a high-frequency action DiT executes short action chunks in closed loop by querying this context through layerwise joint attention. To support asynchronous execution, we introduce horizon-adaptive offset training and Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing (OVCR), which together let the action expert exploit long-horizon world context while remaining responsive to real-time execution state without rerunning the video DiT. Experiments on RoboTwin and real-world manipulation tasks show that AHA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance without any robot-data pretraining, attaining 92.80% average success on RoboTwin and 78.3% success across 4 real-world tasks, while reaching 24.17 Hz closed-loop control with a 4.59x speedup over Fast-WAM.

摘要（中文）：世界-行动模型已成为机器人操作的一种有前景的范式，通过联合建模视觉场景动态与行动，将物理先验注入策略学习。然而，现有世界-行动模型将世界预测与行动执行耦合在相同时间分辨率下，迫使世界分支建模冗余且信息量低的短期帧变化。我们认为，严格将世界预测与行动执行绑定在相同时间节奏上，可能未能充分发挥视频分支在具身控制中的潜力。因此，我们提出AHA-WAM，一种基于双扩散变换器架构的异步自适应时域世界-行动模型，围绕这一时间不对称性重组世界-行动建模。AHA-WAM将视频扩散变换器实例化为低频世界规划器，该规划器维护过去观察的滚动键值记忆，并暴露可复用的分层潜上下文编码以表征长时域场景演化；同时，高频行动扩散变换器通过分层联合注意力机制查询该上下文，在闭环中执行短行动片段。为支持异步执行，我们引入了自适应时域偏移训练与观察引导视频上下文路由，二者共同使行动专家在无需重新运行视频扩散变换器的情况下，既能利用长时域世界上下文，又能保持对实时执行状态的响应能力。在RoboTwin及真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，AHA-WAM无需任何机器人数据预训练即可达到最先进性能，在RoboTwin上取得92.80%的平均成功率，在4项真实世界任务中取得78.3%的成功率，同时实现24.17 Hz的闭环控制，较Fast-WAM加速4.59倍。

Authors: Jisong Cai, Long Ling, Shiwei Chu, Zhongshan Liu, Jiayue Kang, Zhixuan Liang, Wenjie Xu, Yinan Mao, Weinan Zhang, Xiaokang Yang, Ru Ying, Ran Zheng, Yao Mu

SynManDex: Synthesizing Human-like Dexterous Grasps from Synthetic Human Pre-Grasps Manipulation

dexterous grasping human-like grasps force-closure optimization bimanual manipulation VLM agents

简要说明：SynManDex 是一种合成管道，通过利用人类预抓取作为语义提示并优化机器人本体力闭合接触来生成类人灵巧抓取，在仿真和真实双臂灵巧机器人操作中实现了高抓取质量和类人性。

TLDR: SynManDex is a synthetic pipeline that generates human-like dexterous grasps by using human pre-grasps as affordance proposals and optimizing for robot-native force-closure contacts, achieving high grasp quality and human-likeness in both simulation and real-robot bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Human hand-object interactions encode functional intent, but direct transfer to robotic hands often fails under morphology, contact, and reachability constraints. We present SynManDex, a synthetic pipeline that uses generated human pre-grasps as affordance-aware proposals and resolves the final contacts with robot-native optimization. SynManDex samples object-conditioned digital human pre-grasps, retargets them to dexterous robotic hand poses, optimizes force-closure contacts on the target embodiment, and admits trajectories that pass checks from each step. The resulting keyframes support both grasp-and-lift demonstrations and various prehensile manipulation tasks such as tea pouring, photo taking, and flute playing, designed via VLM agents. As a result, SynManDex combines high grasp quality (86.4\% grasp stability) with 4.67/5 human-likeness (93.4\%). It achieves 80.7\% successes in simulation and 25/30 (83.3\%) real-robot successes when applied to a 36-DOF bimanual dexterous robotic platform.

摘要（中文）：人类手-物体交互编码了功能性意图，但在形态、接触和可达性约束下，直接转移到机器人手部往往会失败。我们提出SynManDex，一种合成流程，将生成的人类预抓取作为可供性感知提案，并通过机器人原生优化解决最终接触问题。SynManDex对物体条件化的数字人类预抓取进行采样，将其重定向为灵巧机器人手部姿态，在目标实体上优化力闭合接触，并接受通过每个步骤检查的轨迹。由此产生的关键帧不仅支持抓取与抬升演示，还支持各类抓取操作任务（如倒茶、拍照和吹笛），这些任务由视觉语言模型智能体设计。实验结果表明，SynManDex兼具高抓取质量（86.4%抓取稳定性）与4.67/5的人类相似度（93.4%）。在仿真中达到80.7%的成功率，在应用于36自由度双臂灵巧机器人平台时实现25/30（83.3%）的真实机器人成功操作。

Authors: Yanming Shao, Zanxin Chen, Wenwei Lin, Mingjie Zhou, Tianxing Chen, Xiaokang Yang, Yichen Chi, Yao Mu

AetheRock: An Arm-Worn Robot Teaching System for Force-Guided Vision-Tactile Learning Manipulation

visuo-tactile sensor force-guided learning wearable robot teaching contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了AetheRock，一种臂戴式数据采集设备，配备凝胶触觉传感器和力传感，以及ForceVT，一个利用力和视觉指导触觉学习的表征学习框架，以应对触觉传感器制造和使用中的不一致性。

TLDR: This paper introduces AetheRock, an arm-worn data collection device with a gel-based tactile sensor and force sensing, and ForceVT, a representation learning framework that uses force and vision to enable robust tactile inference despite sensor inconsistencies.

Abstract: Force and tactile sensing are indispensable in contact-rich manipulation. However, force-aware robot learning faces critical challenges due to the incompatible assembly of tactile and force sensors in handheld or wearable devices. To address these limitations, we first introduce AetheRock for gripper-force, vision, and tactile data collection, which is an arm-worn device featuring a modular and easily manufactured visuo-tactile sensor, GelSlim-MiniFab, at the fingertip, a resistive pressure sensor at the human finger contact region, a customized PCB module, and a wearable kit for comfortable and robust collection. Building on this, we propose ForceVT, a representation learning framework that uses force and vision to guide fidelity-agnostic tactile learning, enabling robust inference in any tactile situation. Real-world experiments show that AetheRock achieves qualified data efficiency and that ForceVT effectively alleviates inefficiencies when visuo-tactile sensors exhibit manufacturing and utilization inconsistencies. Overall, our work mitigates the limitations of gripper-force vision-tactile robot learning through innovative hardware design and algorithms.

摘要（中文）：力和触觉感知在接触密集型操作中不可或缺。然而，由于手持或可穿戴设备中触觉传感器与力传感器的装配不兼容，力感知机器人学习面临严峻挑战。为解决这些局限，我们首先提出AetheRock系统——用于夹爪力、视觉与触觉数据采集的臂戴式装置，其指尖部位集成模块化且易于制造的视触觉传感器GelSlim-MiniFab、人体手指接触区域的电阻式压力传感器、定制化PCB模块以及用于舒适稳健数据采集的可穿戴套件。在此基础上，我们提出ForceVT表示学习框架，该框架利用力与视觉引导不依赖忠实度的触觉学习，实现任意触觉情境下的鲁棒推理。实际实验表明，AetheRock具备合格的数据采集效率，且当视触觉传感器存在制造与使用不一致时，ForceVT能有效缓解低效问题。总体而言，本研究通过创新硬件设计与算法，缓解了夹爪力-视觉-触觉机器人学习中的局限性。

Authors: Hong Li, Yue Xu, Yihan Tang, Yankang Dong, Chenyuan Liu, Chenyang Yu, Xuyang Li, Siyuan Huang, Yujun Shen, Nan Xue, Yong-Lu Li

Your Model Already Knows: Attention-Guided Safety Filter for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

VLA models safety filter attention heads collision avoidance Control Barrier Function

简要说明：本文提出一种无需训练的安全过滤器，利用VLA模型的注意力头定位目标物体，并结合轻量级跟踪器实现动态避障。

TLDR: This paper introduces a training-free safety filter for VLA models that uses attention heads to localize the target object and a lightweight tracker for dynamic collision avoidance.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive end-to-end performance across a variety of robotic manipulation tasks. However, these policies offer no guarantees against collisions with task-irrelevant objects in the scene. Existing safety filters sidestep this problem by querying a vision-language model (VLM) to identify obstacles and their locations. This, however, is too slow to run in the control loop and can only be invoked at episode initialization, leaving the filter unable to track moving obstacles. We discover that a small number of attention heads within a VLA model reliably localize the object the policy intends to approach. These heads can be exploited within a training-free safety framework that obtains the active target from the attention heads at every step, treats the remainder of the scene as obstacles, and feeds these into a Control Barrier Function (CBF) filter. Together with a lightweight real-time object tracker, this allows for collision avoidance for non-static obstacles. We evaluate our framework on SafeLIBERO, which we extend with moving obstacles. On the original static benchmark, our method performs comparably to an oracle that uses privileged simulator state to identify the target, emulating a VLM-based identification step run once at episode initialization. On the dynamic variant, where the oracle's init-time target assignment becomes stale, our method substantially outperforms it by 43%, on average. Our findings suggest that the perceptual signals needed for real-time safety filtering are already present within VLA policies and can be exploited without additional training or heavy auxiliary models.

摘要（中文）：**摘要：** 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已在多种机器人操作任务中展现出卓越的端到端性能。然而，这些策略无法保证避免与场景中任务无关的物体发生碰撞。现有安全过滤器通过查询视觉-语言模型（VLM）来识别障碍物及其位置，从而绕过该问题。但这种方法因速度过慢而无法在控制循环中实时运行，仅能在回合初始化时调用，导致过滤器无法追踪移动障碍物。我们发现，VLA模型中的少量注意力头能够可靠地定位策略所意图接近的目标。利用这一特性，我们提出了一种无需额外训练的安全框架：在每一步从这些注意力头中提取当前活动目标，将场景中其余部分视为障碍物，并将其输入控制障碍函数（CBF）过滤器。结合轻量级实时目标追踪器，该方法能够实现对非静态障碍物的避碰。我们在SafeLIBERO基准上（并将其扩展至包含移动障碍物的场景）评估了该框架。在原始静态基准测试中，我们的方法性能与使用特权模拟器状态来识别目标（模拟在回合初始化时执行一次基于VLM的识别步骤）的基线方法相当；而在动态变体中，由于基线方法在初始化时分配的目标随时间失效，我们的方法平均性能显著超出其43%。研究结果表明，实时安全过滤所需的感知信号已内嵌于VLA策略中，无需额外训练或庞大的辅助模型即可加以利用。

Authors: Seongbin Park, Fan Zhang, Baharan Mirzasoleiman, Shahriar Talebi, Nader Sehatbakhsh

ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models Manipulation

failure recovery VLA models hidden-state probe control barrier function training-free intervention

简要说明：ProbeAct提出了一种无需训练的运行时干预框架，通过隐藏状态探测器、运动学状态机和分层CBF过滤器检测并恢复VLA策略中的抓取和放置失败，在LIBERO-plus基准测试中提高了成功率。

TLDR: ProbeAct introduces a training-free runtime intervention framework that detects and recovers from grasping and placement failures in VLA policies using hidden-state probes, a kinematic state machine, and a hierarchical CBF filter, improving success rates on the LIBERO-plus benchmark.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong perfor-1 mance on language-conditioned robotic manipulation within their training dis-2 tribution, yet their generalization capabilities remain fundamentally limited. They3 lack the robustness required to handle perturbations, frequently failing when con-4 fronted with lighting changes, altered camera viewpoints, or small initial-state5 variations. We propose PROBEACT, a training-free runtime intervention frame-6 work that detects and recovers from grasping and placement failures in pre-7 trained VLA policies without modifying their weights or requiring additional8 demonstrations. PROBEACT combines three components: (i) a lightweight multi-9 target hidden-state probe that predicts the 3D positions of task-relevant objects10 from intermediate VLA features, with Hungarian-matched identity tracking for11 multi-object scenes; (ii) an object-agnostic kinematic state machine that detects12 grasp, transport, and placement failures using only gripper-internal signals and13 end-effector kinematics; and (iii) a hierarchical Control Barrier Function (CBF)14 filter that encodes repeated-failure locations as soft safe-set constraints, mini-15 mally correcting VLA actions while preserving baseline behavior. As a plug-and-16 play, training-free intervention loop, PROBEACT is orthogonal to existing train-17 ing pipelines. Evaluated on the LIBERO-plus benchmark, our framework acts as18 a universal safety net, improving the success rate of the OpenVLA-OFT model19 from 69.6% to 74.1%, while demonstrating broad applicability to both base and20 fine-tuned VLA policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在其训练分布内的语言条件机器人操控任务中展现出强大性能，但其泛化能力仍存在根本性局限。这类模型缺乏应对扰动的鲁棒性，在面临光照变化、相机视角改变或微小初始状态变化时经常失败。我们提出PROBEACT，一种无需训练的运行时干预框架，能够在不对预训练VLA策略修改权重或额外采集示范的情况下，检测并恢复其抓取与放置过程中的失败。PROBEACT融合三大组件：(i) 轻量级多目标隐藏状态探针，可从中间VLA特征预测任务相关物体的三维位置，并采用匈牙利匹配身份跟踪算法处理多目标场景；(ii) 与物体无关的运动学状态机，仅利用夹爪内部信号与末端执行器运动学信息即可检测抓取、搬运与放置失败；(iii) 分级控制障碍函数（CBF）滤波器，将重复失败位置编码为软安全约束，在最小化修正VLA动作的同时保留基线行为。作为即插即用且无需训练的干预回路，PROBEACT与现有训练流程正交。在LIBERO-plus基准上的评估表明，我们的框架可作为通用安全网，将OpenVLA-OFT模型成功率从69.6%提升至74.1%，同时展现出对基础与微调VLA策略的广泛适用性。

Authors: Fan Zhang, Seongbin Park, Baharan Mirzasoleiman, Shariar Talebi, Nader Sehatbakhsh

ReCoVLA: VLM-Guided Reward Compilation for Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Policies Manipulation

failure-conditioned residual recovery VLM-guided reward compilation zero-shot sim-to-real vision-language-action policies manipulation

简要说明：ReCoVLA 提出了一种利用视觉语言模型作为语义奖励选择器的框架，为冻结的视觉-语言-动作策略编译恢复策略，通过零样本仿真到现实迁移在操作任务中实现更好的故障恢复。

TLDR: ReCoVLA presents a framework that uses a VLM as a semantic reward selector to compile recovery policies for frozen VLA models, achieving improved failure recovery in manipulation tasks via zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for language-conditioned manipulation, but remain brittle in off-nominal states requiring targeted recovery. We propose ReCoVLA -- a failure-conditioned residual recovery framework that keeps a pretrained VLA policy frozen, uses an external vision-language model (VLM) to infer the failure mode and recovery stage, and compiles a structured reward from task-relevant components. Rather than using the VLM to generate actions or rewards directly, ReCoVLA uses it as a semantic reward selector: it predicts a recovery descriptor and reward mask for in-simulation residual-policy training, followed by zero-shot sim-to-real deployment of the trained recovery policies. This decouples high-level failure understanding from low-level corrective control to support different VLAs. Experiments across short-horizon, long-horizon, and contact-rich manipulation tasks show that ReCoVLA outperforms the tested baselines on average. In simulation, our reward compiler improves average success from 36.7% for the fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ baseline to 66.7%. In physical zero-shot sim-to-real experiments, ReCoVLA achieves the best average performance, with 61.7% success.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为语言条件操控提供了强大的先验知识，但在需要针对性恢复的非标称状态下仍显脆弱。我们提出ReCoVLA——一种基于故障条件的残差恢复框架，该框架保持预训练VLA策略冻结，利用外部视觉语言模型（VLM）推断故障模式与恢复阶段，并从任务相关组件中编译结构化奖励。ReCoVLA并非直接使用VLM生成动作或奖励，而是将其作为语义奖励选择器：它预测恢复描述符与奖励掩码，用于仿真环境中的残差策略训练，随后将训练好的恢复策略进行零样本的仿真到现实迁移。这种设计将高层级故障理解与低层级修正控制解耦，从而支持不同VLA策略。在短视距、长视距及接触密集操控任务上的实验表明，ReCoVLA在平均性能上优于测试基线。在仿真中，我们的奖励编译器将微调后的π₀.₅基线的平均成功率从36.7%提升至66.7%。在物理世界的零样本仿真到现实实验中，ReCoVLA取得了最佳平均性能，成功率达61.7%。

Authors: Haodi Hu, Chung-Ta Huang, Jing Liu, Ye Wang, Kei Suzuki, Matthew Brand, Toshiaki Koike-Akino

DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience Manipulation

dexterous manipulation imitation learning DAgger relative action space optimality indicator

简要说明：DexPIE是一个后训练框架，通过交互式DAgger数据采集、相对动作空间的异步推理以及连续最优性指示器，在真实世界的灵巧操作任务上实现了37%的成功率提升。

TLDR: DexPIE is a post-training framework that improves dexterous manipulation policies by collecting real-world experience via interactive DAgger-style data collection and using an asynchronous inference in relative action space with a continuous optimality indicator, achieving 37% higher success rate on real-world tasks.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation presents substantial challenges for imitation learning due to its high-dimensional action space and complex contact-rich dynamics. Policies trained purely from demonstrations often suffer from compounding errors during deployment and require large amounts of expert data to achieve reliable performance. To move beyond the limitations of demonstration data, in this work, we propose DexPIE, a post-training framework for dexterous policy improvement from experience collected through real-world deployment. First, DexPIE enables effective exploration coverage through a dexterous-hand-adapted intervention system and multi-stage DAgger-style data collection across initial and intermediate task stages, providing reliable supervision for accurate policy evaluation. To reduce temporal noise between post-training rollouts and demonstration data, we introduce asynchronous inference in the relative action space, which better aligns rollout data with demonstrated behavior and allows the critic to learn a value function induced by a more consistent underlying policy. Finally, DexPIE improves the policy through conditioning on a continuous optimality indicator, allowing the policy to leverage the quality of data in a more fine-grained manner. Across three challenging real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, DexPIE achieves a 37% improvement in success rate over the demonstration-based reference policy, outperforming all baseline methods and demonstrating stronger robustness. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available.

摘要（中文）：摘要：灵巧操作因其高维动作空间和复杂的接触丰富动力学特性，为模仿学习带来了巨大挑战。仅依赖示教数据进行训练的部署策略容易出现累积误差，且需要大量专家数据才能达到可靠性能。为突破示教数据的局限性，本文提出DexPIE——一种基于真实部署经验提升灵巧策略性能的后训练框架。首先，DexPIE通过适配灵巧手的干预系统与多阶段DAgger式数据采集（覆盖任务初始及中间阶段）实现有效探索覆盖，为精准策略评估提供可靠监督。为降低后训练轨迹与示教数据之间的时序噪声，我们引入相对动作空间的异步推理机制，使轨迹数据与示教行为更一致，从而让评论家学习由更稳定底层策略诱导的价值函数。最后，DexPIE通过连续最优性指标的条件化策略改进，使策略能够以更细粒度方式利用数据质量。在三个具有挑战性的真实灵巧操作任务中，DexPIE相比基于示教的参考策略成功率达37%的提升，超越所有基线方法并展现出更强鲁棒性。相关源代码与数据集将公开提供。

Authors: Ruizhe Liao, Wenrui Chen, Liangji Zeng, Haoran Lin, Fan Yang, Kailun Yang, Yaonan Wang

CT-VAM: A Cerebello-Thalamic-Inspired Vision-Action Model for Efficient Visuomotor Control VLA

vision-action model visuomotor control stream-separated attention dual-view visual observations asynchronous chunk execution

简要说明：CT-VAM 提出了一种受小脑-丘脑通路启发的紧凑型视觉-动作模型（68M参数），采用流分离注意力解码器（TARS）在资源受限的机器人上实现高效视觉运动控制，性能与更大的VLA模型相当。

TLDR: CT-VAM proposes a compact vision-action model (68M parameters) inspired by cerebellar-thalamic pathways, using a stream-separated attention decoder (TARS) for efficient visuomotor control on resource-constrained robots, achieving competitive performance with larger VLA models.

Abstract: Vision-language-action models have shown strong promise for robot manipulation, yet raw language is primarily needed to specify task intent rather than to be repeatedly processed during high-frequency low-level execution. Motivated by this separation, we propose a cerebello-thalamic-inspired vision-action model (CT-VAM) for efficient task-conditioned visuomotor control. CT-VAM acts as a compact local execution policy that predicts action chunks from dualview visual observations, proprioception, and a lightweight task condition, potentially enabling a practical cloud-edge paradigm in which high-level semantic reasoning can be handled by large models while fast closed-loop control runs on local hardware. To fuse heterogeneous inputs effectively, CT-VAM introduces TARS (Thalamic Action Routing Stream), a stream-separated conditional attention decoder that independently routes action, visual and task streams, preventing dense sensory tokens from overwhelming compact task-relevant conditions. With only 68M parameters, CT-VAM achieves LIBERO success rates competitive with substantially larger VLA models, while reducing inference latency. Together with flow-consistent inpainting for asynchronous chunk execution, CT-VAM supports high-frequency control and demonstrates robust realworld deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操控领域展现出巨大潜力，但原始语言主要用于指定任务意图，而非在高频低层执行过程中反复处理。基于这一分离特性，我们提出了一种受小脑-丘脑启发的视觉-动作模型（CT-VAM），用于高效的任务条件化视觉运动控制。CT-VAM作为一种紧凑的局部执行策略，能够从双视角视觉观测、本体感知以及轻量级任务条件中预测动作片段，从而支持一种实用的云-边协同架构：高层语义推理由大模型处理，而快速闭环控制则在本地硬件上运行。为有效融合异构输入，CT-VAM引入了TARS（丘脑动作路由流）——一种流分离条件注意力解码器，可将动作、视觉和任务流独立路由，防止密集的感知标记淹没紧凑的任务相关条件。仅含6800万参数的CT-VAM，在LIBERO基准测试中取得了与规模更大的VLA模型相当的成功率，同时降低了推理延迟。结合用于异步动作执行的流一致修补技术，CT-VAM支持高频控制，并在资源受限的机器人平台上展现出稳健的真实世界部署能力。

Authors: Jiacheng Li, Yize Guo, Jiabin Guo, Qingchen Liu, Jiahu Qin

Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines WorldModel

world models data poisoning robot learning backdoor attack VLA

简要说明：本文揭示了机器人学习流程中世界模型的一种新型数据投毒攻击，表明隐藏在安全数据集中的恶意提示或转换可通过世界模型激活，生成危险的合成轨迹并导致策略被破坏。

TLDR: This paper exposes a novel data poisoning attack on world models in robot learning pipelines, showing that malicious prompts or transitions hidden in safe datasets can be activated by world models to generate dangerous synthetic trajectories and compromised policies.

Abstract: World models have recently seen a rapid growth in both their popularity and capability as more data efficient tools for generating robot training data or simulating real world environments, with many works proposing their integration into the robot learning pipeline. While highly practical, in this work we demonstrate that world models introduce a uniquely stealthy and effective data poisoning entry point into the robot learning supply chain that can result in the deployment of unsafe or otherwise compromised robotic policies despite training on seemingly safe ground truth training data. In contrast to traditional data poisoning techniques which directly implant dangerous trajectories into sold or uploaded datasets, our novel attack methods inject malicious prompts or compromising transition dynamics into visibly safe teleoperated datasets which are only activated once fed through a world model as input. This can result in the generation of synthetic, dangerous robot training trajectories and subsequently unsafe or compromised robot policies. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our attacks against both state of the art action conditioned and text conditioned world models, showing a full end-to-end backdoor on a downstream DRL policy and a proof-of-concept for the VLA setting. Overall these findings necessitate research into more secure world models and reevaluating their position within the robot learning supply chain.

摘要（中文）：世界模型近期在生成机器人训练数据或模拟真实环境方面的流行度和能力均快速增长，作为一种更高效的数据工具，许多研究建议将其整合到机器人学习流程中。尽管具有高度实用性，本研究证明世界模型在机器人学习供应链中引入了一种独特且隐蔽的数据投毒切入点，可能导致即便基于看似安全的地面真实训练数据，仍会部署不安全或受损害的机器人策略。与传统数据投毒技术（直接将危险轨迹植入已售出或上传的数据集）不同，我们的新型攻击方法将恶意提示或受损的转移动态注入到视觉安全的远程操作数据集中，这些恶意内容仅当数据被输入世界模型作为处理时才会被激活。这可能导致生成合成性危险机器人训练轨迹，进而产生不安全或受损害的机器人策略。我们针对当前最先进的基于动作条件与文本条件的世界模型验证了攻击的有效性，展示了在下游深度强化学习策略上的完整端到端后门攻击，以及在视觉-语言-动作范式中的概念验证。总体而言，这些发现要求对更安全的世界模型进行研究，并重新评估其在机器人学习供应链中的地位。

Authors: Ethan Rathbun, Ahmed Agha, Saaduddin Mahmud, Christopher Amato, Alina Oprea, Eugene Bagdasarian

$ω$-EVA: Envision, Verify, and Act with Latent Interactive World Models WorldModel

latent interactive world model action-conditioned latent dynamics Envision-Verify-Act loop tri-branch refiner embodied action generation

简要说明：ω-EVA 提出了一种潜在交互式世界模型，实现“设想-验证-行动”循环以生成具身动作，通过动作条件潜在动力学和三分支精炼器提升策略决策，无需生成显式视频。

TLDR: ω-EVA introduces a latent interactive world model that enables an Envision-Verify-Act loop for embodied action generation, using action-conditioned latent dynamics and a tri-branch refiner to improve policy decision-making without explicit video generation.

Abstract: Embodied policies typically map current observations directly to actions, leaving candidate-action consequences implicit. World models provide predictive supervision, representations, or external simulation, but rarely let a policy inspect the imagined consequence of its own proposal before acting. We introduce $ω$-EVA, a latent interactive world model that realizes an Envision--Verify--Act loop for embodied action generation. Its three-stage framework learns action-conditioned latent dynamics, trains a language-conditioned flow policy on dynamics-aware visual representations, and feeds the policy's proposal back through the world model. A tri-branch refiner jointly reasons over the current state, proposal-conditioned future, and proposed action to produce the final action chunk. Because consequence reasoning remains in latent feature space, $ω$-EVA avoids generating future videos at inference. Evaluations across diverse single-arm, bimanual, long-horizon, and perturbed simulation settings show that the complete interaction pipeline consistently improves the proposal policy, while latent diagnostics indicate meaningful action-conditioned future structure. With approximately 1.2B parameters and no additional robot-data pretraining, $ω$-EVA demonstrates a compact and competitive performance--scale--data trade-off, making the world model an active action-feedback module rather than a passive predictor.

摘要（中文）：具身策略通常直接将当前观测映射到动作，使得候选动作的后果隐而不显。世界模型虽能提供预测性监督、表征或外部仿真，但很少能让策略在执行动作前审视自身提议所设想的后果。我们提出$ω$-EVA，一种潜在交互式世界模型，它实现了用于具身动作生成的"设想—验证—执行"循环。该模型的三阶段框架包含：学习动作条件化的潜在动力学、在动力学感知的视觉表征上训练语言条件化的流式策略、以及通过世界模型对策略的提议进行反馈。一个三分支精炼器联合推理当前状态、提议条件化的未来状态以及提议动作，以生成最终的动作片段。由于后果推理仍在潜在特征空间中进行，$ω$-EVA在推理时无需生成未来视频。在多种单臂、双臂、长时域及受扰仿真场景中的评估表明，完整的交互流程持续改进了提议策略的性能，而潜在诊断分析则显示出有意义的动作条件化未来结构。在参数约12亿且无需额外机器人数据预训练的条件下，$ω$-EVA展现出紧凑且具有竞争力的性能—规模—数据权衡，使世界模型成为主动的动作反馈模块，而非被动的预测器。

Authors: Zhenguo Sun, Yu Sun, Hande Huang, Alois Knoll

Uncertainty-Aware Motion Planning for Autonomous Driving in Mixed Traffic Environment AutonomousDriving

uncertainty-aware motion planning mixed traffic human intent prediction reinforcement learning autonomous driving

简要说明：UAMP提出了一种方法，将人类意图预测中的不确定性纳入自动驾驶决策，通过临近感知不确定性估计器和不确定性校准值学习提高安全性。

TLDR: UAMP proposes a method to incorporate uncertainty in human intent prediction for safer autonomous driving in mixed-traffic environments, using a proximity-aware uncertainty estimator and uncertainty-calibrated value learning.

Abstract: In mixed-traffic environments where autonomous and human-driven vehicles may co-exist, motion planning for autonomous vehicles requires anticipating the future behaviors of surrounding human drivers. Existing reinforcement learning-based methods generally directly incorporate the predicted human intents into the observation to enable a proactive planning. However, human intent is inherently uncertain due to the behavioral diversity, perception noise, and partial observability. Treating predicted intends as deterministic states can result in unsafe decisions for autonomous vehicles. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Motion Planning (UAMP), which incorporates uncertainty in human intent prediction for AV decision-making. Specifically, UAMP first introduces a proximity-aware uncertainty estimator to quantify the interaction-conditioned intent uncertainty and constructs an uncertainty-guided joint intent distribution over surrounding human-driven vehicles. Within this uncertainty set, UAMP further introduces Uncertainty-Calibrated Value Learning (UCVL) to correct value function learning biases arising from directly incorporating uncertain human intent predictions into the observation. Extensive experiments in various mixed-traffic scenarios show that UAMP significantly improves safety and driving comfort, while maintaining traffic efficiency compared with existing approaches. The code is released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UAMP-5638.

摘要（中文）：在自动驾驶车辆与人类驾驶车辆共存的混合交通环境中，自动驾驶的运动规划需要预判周围人类驾驶员的未来行为。现有基于强化学习的方法通常将预测的人类意图直接纳入观测信息中，以实现前瞻性规划。然而，由于行为多样性、感知噪声及部分可观测性，人类意图本身具有不确定性。将预测意图视为确定性状态可能导致自动驾驶车辆做出不安全决策。为解决这一问题，我们提出不确定性感知运动规划（UAMP），该方法将人类意图预测的不确定性融入自动驾驶决策中。具体而言，UAMP首先引入邻近感知不确定性估计器，量化交互条件下的意图不确定性，并构建受不确定性引导的周围人类驾驶车辆联合意图分布。在此不确定性集内，UAMP进一步提出不确定性校准值学习（UCVL），以修正因将不确定的人类意图预测直接纳入观测信息而导致的估值函数学习偏差。在多种混合交通场景中的大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，UAMP在保持交通效率的同时显著提升了安全性与驾驶舒适性。相关代码已开源至https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UAMP-5638。

Authors: Ming Cheng, Hao Chen, Ziyi Yang, Ziluowen Luo, Senzhang Wang

ReGIL: Retrieval-Guided Imitation Learning from a Single Demonstration Manipulation

retrieval-guided imitation learning single demonstration robot manipulation online training reward construction

简要说明：ReGIL 将单个演示视为可重用的外部记忆，通过检索引导探索、生成正则化缓冲区并构建奖励，实现高效的机器人操作学习。

TLDR: ReGIL treats a single demonstration as reusable external memory, using retrieval to guide exploration, generate regularization buffers, and construct rewards for efficient robot manipulation learning.

Abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies with deep neural networks from a single demonstration remains highly challenging, as even small deviations from the demonstrated trajectory can quickly compound into failure, while collecting substantial online interaction data is costly. We propose ReGIL, a retrieval-guided imitation learning framework that treats a single demonstration as an external memory. ReGIL repeatedly queries this static memory throughout training to simultaneously guide exploration, generate the regularization buffer, and construct rewards. Specifically, it computes rewards through local temporal alignment between the current trajectory and the retrieved segment, providing step-wise and informative feedback for policy improvement. We evaluate ReGIL on robotic manipulation tasks from the LIBERO and Meta-World benchmarks under the single demonstration setting. ReGIL outperforms prior baselines in both success rate and training efficiency. In real-robot experiments, using only one demonstration and less than one hour of online training, ReGIL achieves over 75% success rate across three manipulation tasks with randomness in both initial robot pose and target position. These results demonstrate that leveraging the single demonstration as reusable memory can provide more than static supervision for efficient robot learning. More details can be found on our website: https://regil2026.github.io/

摘要（中文）：摘要： 利用深度神经网络从单一示范中学习机器人操作策略仍然极具挑战性，因为即使与示范轨迹存在微小偏差，也可能迅速累积导致任务失败，而收集大量的在线交互数据成本高昂。我们提出ReGIL，一种检索引导的模仿学习框架，将单一示范视为外部记忆。ReGIL在训练过程中反复查询这一静态记忆，同时用于引导探索、生成正则化缓冲区和构建奖励。具体而言，它通过当前轨迹与检索片段之间的局部时间对齐计算奖励，为策略改进提供逐步且信息丰富的反馈。我们在LIBERO和Meta-World基准的机器人操作任务上，在单一示范设置下评估了ReGIL。ReGIL在成功率和训练效率两方面均优于先前基线方法。在真实机器人实验中，仅使用一次示范和不到一小时的在线训练，ReGIL在三个操作任务上实现了超过75%的成功率，且初始机器人位姿与目标位置均具有随机性。这些结果表明，将单一示范作为可复用记忆，能够为高效机器人学习提供超越静态监督的支持。更多详情请访问我们的网站：https://regil2026.github.io/

Authors: Yuying Zhang, Francesco Verdoja, Wenyan Yang, Ville Kyrki

TORL-VLA: Tactile Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation Manipulation

tactile feedback online reinforcement learning contact-rich manipulation VLA intervention-censored critic

简要说明：TORL-VLA将触觉反馈与在线强化学习模块相结合，使策略能够在接触丰富的操作中实时适应，从而克服了离线VLA策略在接触条件变化时的局限性。

TLDR: TORL-VLA integrates tactile feedback with an online reinforcement learning module to enable real-time policy adaptation in contact-rich manipulation, overcoming the limitations of offline VLA policies under shifting contact conditions.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful framework for robotic manipulation, and recent studies have introduced tactile or force feedback into VLAs to address contact-rich tasks. However, these models are typically deployed as offline policies. When contact conditions shift from the training distribution, the policy cannot perform online adaptation, leading to problems such as inappropriate contact forces and inefficient retries. Therefore, we propose TORL-VLA, a tactile-guided online reinforcement learning framework that couples tactile feedback with policy refinement for contact-rich manipulation. Our method introduces a tactile-derived wrench-aware VLA to predict reference actions and future wrench sequences, while a lightweight online RL module is used to refine the reference actions. To stabilize learning from mixed exploratory policy-generated and human-intervention data, we introduce an intervention-censored critic that prevents post-intervention success from being wrongly credited to policy-generated actions preceding intervention. Real-robot experiments on long-horizon contact-rich tasks, including latch manipulation, coffee-cup placement, and egg handling, show that TORL-VLA improves success rates at both subtask and full-task levels, as well as time-bounded execution efficiency over strong baselines.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人操作领域的强大框架，近期研究将触觉或力反馈引入VLA以应对高接触任务。然而，这些模型通常作为离线策略部署。当接触条件偏离训练数据分布时，策略无法进行在线自适应，导致接触力不当、重试效率低下等问题。为此，我们提出TORL-VLA——一种触觉引导的在线强化学习框架，该框架将触觉反馈与策略优化耦合以完成高接触操作。我们的方法引入触觉衍生的力矩感知VLA来预测参考动作与未来力矩序列，同时采用轻量级在线强化学习模块对参考动作进行优化。为稳定学习来自探索性策略生成数据与人工干预数据的混合样本，我们提出干预截断评判器，防止干预后的成功结果被错误归因于干预前的策略生成动作。在包含门闩操作、咖啡杯放置及鸡蛋处理等长时域高接触任务的真实机器人实验中，TORL-VLA在子任务与完整任务层面均提升了成功率，并在时间约束执行效率上显著超越强基线方法。

Authors: Huaihang Zheng, Yi Yang, Kai Ma, Shenglin Xu, Tian Xie, Guozheng Li, Xiangyu Wang, Yiren Ma, Si Liu, Yinian Mao, Baoxu Liu

VAIC: Vision-Guided Humanoid Agile Object Interaction Control via Decoupled Commands HumanoidEmbodied

two-stage distillation recurrent object adaptation whole-body coordination depth and proprioception decoupled user command

简要说明：VAIC提出了一种两阶段蒸馏框架，使类人机器人仅依靠机载深度和本体感知即可执行敏捷的全身交互动作（如搬运、推车、滑板），无需密集参考轨迹或完全状态可观测性。

TLDR: VAIC introduces a two-stage distillation framework that enables humanoid robots to perform agile whole-body interactions (e.g., carrying, carting, skateboarding) using only onboard depth and proprioception, without requiring dense reference trajectories or full state observability.

Abstract: Humanoid robots hold immense potential for real-world assistance, yet agile interaction with objects in unstructured environments demands tightly coupled whole-body coordination. Despite recent advancements, current controllers face a critical deployment gap. They rely heavily on dense reference trajectories and perfect state observability, which inherently limits physical generalization. We present Vision Guided Agile Interaction Control (VAIC), a unified framework that bridges this gap by operating exclusively on onboard depth, historical proprioception, and a decoupled user command interface. VAIC employs a two-stage distillation paradigm. First, a privileged teacher policy masters diverse interaction skills using precise object kinematics and exact environmental states. Second, a deployable student policy distills these capabilities by replacing full body tracking with velocity targets across multiple axes and an interaction indicator for each frame. The student utilizes a recurrent object adaptation module to implicitly infer unobservable object dynamics from raw depth streams and proprioception. Evaluations and real-world deployments on the humanoid robot demonstrate that a single VAIC policy successfully executes highly diverse dynamic tasks. These tasks include box carrying, cart interaction, and skateboarding, consistently outperforming baselines and advancing autonomous humanoid deployment.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人在现实世界协助中具有巨大潜力，但在非结构化环境中与物体进行敏捷交互需要紧密耦合的全身协调。尽管近年来取得进展，现有控制器仍面临关键部署鸿沟：它们严重依赖密集参考轨迹和完美状态可观测性，这从根本上限制了物理泛化能力。我们提出视觉引导敏捷交互控制（VAIC），该统一框架仅通过机载深度信息、历史本体感知和解耦的用户命令接口来弥合这一鸿沟。VAIC采用两阶段蒸馏范式：首先，特权教师策略利用精确物体运动学和环境状态掌握多样交互技能；其次，可部署学生策略通过将全身跟踪替换为多轴速度目标与每帧交互指示器来蒸馏这些能力。学生策略利用循环物体适配模块，从原始深度流和本体感知中隐式推断不可观测的物体动力学。在人形机器人上的评估和实际部署表明，单个VAIC策略可成功执行高度多样化的动态任务，包括搬运箱子、推车交互和滑板运动，始终优于基线方法并推动自主人形机器人的部署进展。

Authors: Dongting Li, Qianyang Wu, Xingyu Chen, Liang Li, Yuhang Lin, Sikai Wu, Guoyao Zhang, Mingliang Zhou, Diyun Xiang, Qiang Zhang, Renjing Xu, Jianzhu Ma

Back to the Familiar Future: Failure Recovery for VLA Policies via Pre-Imagined Milestone Selection VLA

VLA failure recovery future visual conditioning milestone bank manipulation

简要说明：B2FF提出了一种针对VLA策略的恢复框架，利用预想象的未来视觉条件里程碑来引导偏离轨迹状态的恢复，在注入失败的操纵任务中提高了成功率。

TLDR: B2FF proposes a recovery framework for VLA policies that uses pre-imagined milestones from future visual conditioning to guide recovery from off-trajectory states, improving success rates on failure-injected manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can deviate from nominal trajectories during manipulation, even when tasks remain physically feasible. Recovering from these deviations is challenging, as they push the policy into unfamiliar state spaces where direct re-planning frequently destabilizes action sequences. We propose Back to the Familiar Future (B2FF), a recovery framework for foresight-driven VLAs that leverages future visual conditioning as a recovery interface. Before execution, the VLA generates a milestone bank of familiar future states conditioned on the clean initial observation. At recovery time, a recoverability-aware selector selects a recovery milestone from this bank and enforces it as a fixed visual goal. This enables the VLA to robustly map off-trajectory observations back to a familiar future. On failure-injected LIBERO, under controlled recovery timing aligned with the injected failure, B2FF increases the average success rate of a baseline VLA from 56.3% to 74.0%, demonstrating that pre-imagined milestones can guide recovery without fine-tuning the low-level action generator.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在操作过程中可能偏离标称轨迹，即使任务在物理上仍然可行。从这些偏离中恢复具有挑战性，因为偏离会使策略进入不熟悉的状态空间，而直接重新规划往往会 destabilize 动作序列。我们提出“回到熟悉的未来”（B2FF），一种面向前瞻性VLA的恢复框架，利用未来视觉条件作为恢复接口。在执行前，VLA基于干净的初始观测生成一个由熟悉未来状态组成的里程碑库。在恢复时，可恢复性感知选择器从该库中选择一个恢复里程碑，并将其作为固定的视觉目标强制执行。这使得VLA能够将偏离轨迹的观测鲁棒地映射回一个熟悉的未来。在注入失败的LIBERO基准测试中，在受控的恢复时间与注入失败对齐的条件下，B2FF将基线VLA的平均成功率从56.3%提升至74.0%，证明预想象的里程碑能够在无需微调底层动作生成器的情况下引导恢复。

Authors: Suyeon Shin, Juwon Kim, Hyeonbin Park, Hyunseo Kim, Hyundo Lee, Hyung-Sin Kim, Byoung-Tak Zhang

MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation HumanoidEmbodied

world action model humanoid loco-manipulation unified motion latent whole-body control egocentric video world model

简要说明：MotionWAM 将世界动作模型从桌面操作扩展到实时人形全身操作，用统一运动潜变量替代上下半身分层结构，并通过三阶段训练框架在九个真实 Unitree G1 任务上比 VLA 基线提升超过 30%。

TLDR: MotionWAM extends world action models from tabletop manipulation to real-time humanoid loco-manipulation by replacing the hierarchical upper-lower body split with a unified motion latent and a three-stage training pipeline, achieving over 30% improvement over VLA baselines on nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands -- placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper-lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space. A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. On nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks, MotionWAM runs in real time, substantially outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines fine-tuned on the same demonstrations by over 30% in overall success rate, and executes task-driven foot interaction that decoupled upper-lower policies cannot reach. Our results suggest that video-pretrained WAMs can be lifted from tabletop manipulation to coordinated, human-like whole-body humanoid control.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）将视频动力学先验与策略相结合，在桌面操控任务中展现出令人鼓舞的效果，但高维视频-动作隐变量的迭代去噪过程使其速度过慢，无法满足实时的人形机器人的全身操控需求。当前主流的分层范式进一步加剧了这一问题：高层操控策略仅控制上半身，而底层控制器追踪粗略的基础指令——这使得上下半身处于不一致的动作空间中，并将腿部运动降级为维持平衡的行走。我们提出MotionWAM，一种实时世界动作模型，通过将策略基于视频世界模型的中间去噪特征，仅依靠单台第一人称摄像头即可驱动自主人形机器人的全身操控。MotionWAM用统一的动作隐变量替代上下半身分离的方式，在单一动作空间中预测覆盖行走、躯干运动、高度调节、足部交互和手部操控的全身动作令牌。一个三阶段学习框架逐步将视频世界模型适配至第一人称视觉动力学以及目标人形机器人实体。在九项真实的宇树G1机器人任务中，MotionWAM实现实时运行，总体成功率比基于相同演示数据微调的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基线模型高出30%以上，并能执行解耦式上下半身策略无法实现的任务驱动型足部交互。我们的结果表明，经视频预训练的世界动作模型能够从桌面操控推广至协调、类人的全身人形机器人控制。

Authors: Jia Zheng, Teli Ma, Yudong Fan, Zifan Wang, Shuo Yang, Junwei Liang

SpaceVLN: A Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation Agent with Online Spatial Cognitive Memory and Reasoning VLN

Spatial Cognitive Memory Task-Guided Spatial Reasoning Spatial-CoT zero-shot navigation Vision-and-Language Navigation

简要说明：SpaceVLN 提出了一种具有空间认知记忆和任务引导空间推理的零样本视觉与语言导航智能体，在多个基准测试和真实机器人部署中达到最优性能。

TLDR: SpaceVLN introduces a zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation agent with Spatial Cognitive Memory and task-guided spatial reasoning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks and real-robot deployment.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation in continuous environments requires agents to understand the spatial structure of previously unseen environments in order to follow language instructions. Although foundation models have opened a promising path toward zero-shot navigation without task-specific policy training, many navigators still rely on local visual cues and linear history-based reasoning, overlooking the spatial nature of navigation across explored regions, traversed paths, landmarks, and their spatial relations. In this paper, we propose SpaceVLN, a navigation agent built around Spatial Cognitive Memory and Task-Guided Spatial Reasoning. Specifically, SpaceVLN introduces an efficient stagewise closed-loop framework where planning and execution are organized around verifiable space--landmark stages. During navigation, the agent progressively abstracts explored regions into Spatial Waypoints and dynamically maintains subtask-grounded landmark evidence, forming a hierarchical Spatial Cognitive Memory for progress localization and spatial-relation understanding. Built on this memory, Spatial-CoT integrates task-progress reasoning with spatial perception, analysis, and prediction, enabling Task-Guided Spatial Reasoning for embodied navigation. The unified stage interface enables SpaceVLN to address both Vision-and-Language Navigation and Object-Goal Navigation under a unified zero-shot setting, without task-specific policy training. Across R2R-CE, RxR-CE, GN-Bench, and HM3D-OVON, SpaceVLN achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, and real-robot deployment further validates its applicability. These results highlight Spatial Cognitive Memory and Task-Guided Spatial Reasoning as a practical foundation for stronger embodied navigation agents.

摘要（中文）：连续环境下的视觉与语言导航要求智能体理解未曾见过环境的空间结构，以便遵循语言指令执行导航任务。尽管基础模型为零样本导航（无需针对特定任务进行策略训练）开辟了有前景的路径，但许多导航器仍依赖局部视觉线索和基于线性历史记录的推理，忽视了跨越已探索区域、已遍历路径、地标及其空间关系这一导航任务的本质空间特性。本文提出SpaceVLN——一种基于空间认知记忆与任务引导空间推理的导航智能体。具体而言，SpaceVLN引入了高效的阶段性闭环框架，在该框架中规划与执行围绕可验证的空间-地标阶段进行组织。导航过程中，智能体逐步将已探索区域抽象为空间路标点，并动态维护子任务驱动的地标证据，从而形成用于进度定位与空间关系理解的层次化空间认知记忆。基于该记忆，Spatial-CoT将任务进度推理与空间感知、分析与预测相融合，实现了面向具身导航的任务引导空间推理。统一阶段接口使SpaceVLN能够在无需针对特定任务策略训练的统一零样本设置下，同时解决视觉与语言导航以及物体目标导航两项任务。在R2R-CE、RxR-CE、GN-Bench和HM3D-OVON基准测试中，SpaceVLN取得了最先进的零样本性能，而真实机器人部署进一步验证了其适用性。这些结果凸显了空间认知记忆与任务引导空间推理作为构建更强具身导航智能体的实用基础。

Authors: Yucheng Deng, Pingrui Lai, Xinhai Li, Chenjia Bai, Xiaoheng Deng, Chengnuo Sun, Xuelong Li, Hua Yang

C$^3$ache: Accelerating World Action Models with Cross Inference Chunk Cache WorldModel

world action models inference acceleration cross-chunk caching denoising residuals Fast-WAM

简要说明：C$^3$ache 通过跨推理块缓存和重用去噪残差来加速世界行动模型，实现高达 2.5 倍的推理速度提升，且任务成功率几乎不受影响。

TLDR: C$^3$ache accelerates World Action Models by caching and reusing denoising residuals across inference chunks, achieving up to 2.5x faster inference with minimal performance loss.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) generalize better than standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies to novel motions and environments, because a video-modeling objective lets them learn from abundant unlabeled video rather than scarce labeled robot demonstrations. This generalization is computationally expensive. To complete a task, a WAM runs over multiple inference chunks, and each chunk requires a costly denoising process. Existing acceleration methods reduce this cost by caching and reusing computation within a single chunk's denoising trajectory. Our empirical analysis reveals a substantial source of redundancy they overlook: redundancy across chunks. When a robot executes a smooth behavior, the residuals computed at a given denoising step are strongly correlated from one chunk to the next. We introduce C$^3$ache, a training-free method that caches and reuses these residuals across inference chunks at the same denoising step. Experiments on benchmarks with a Fast-WAM backbone show that C$^3$ache achieves up to a $2.5\times$ speedup in total wall-clock inference time, with negligible degradation in task success rate.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）在泛化到新动作和新环境方面优于标准的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，这是因为视频建模目标使它们能够从海量无标签视频中学习，而非依赖稀缺的有标签机器人演示数据。然而，这种泛化能力带来了高昂的计算成本。为完成一项任务，WAM需要运行多个推理片段，每个片段都需执行代价昂贵的去噪过程。现有加速方法通过缓存并复用单一片段去噪轨迹内的计算结果来降低此类成本。我们的实证分析揭示了这些方法忽略的一个重大冗余来源：片段间的冗余。当机器人执行平滑动作时，在给定去噪步骤计算出的残差在相邻片段间存在强相关性。为此，我们提出C$^3$ache——一种无需训练的方法，该方法在相同去噪步骤下跨推理片段缓存并复用这些残差。基于Fast-WAM骨干网络的基准实验表明，C$^3$ache在总端到端推理时间上实现了最高$2.5\times$的加速，同时任务成功率的下降可忽略不计。

Authors: Weisen Zhao, Lam Nguyen, Zhicong Lu, Yuzhang Shang

PTDL:Multi-Terrain Fall Recovery via Phase-Terrain Decoupled Learning Locomotion

humanoid fall recovery phase-terrain decoupled learning projected-gravity-gated discriminator terrain-stratified reward shaping Unitree G1

简要说明：PTDL提出一种相位-地形解耦学习框架，使单个本体感受策略能够在多种地形（平地、砾石、斜坡）上完成集成摔倒恢复与行走，无需部署时提供地形标签。

TLDR: PTDL proposes a phase-terrain decoupled learning framework that enables a single proprioceptive policy to perform integrated fall recovery and locomotion on diverse terrains (flat, gravel, slopes) without requiring terrain labels at deployment.

Abstract: Humanoid robots can fall on slopes, gravel, and uneven ground in unstructured environments. We target integrated fall recovery and locomotion: rebuilding balance from a fallen state using proprioception alone and resuming velocity-commanded walking at the fall site. Prior methods often stop at quasi-static rise, neglect the post-fall ground-contact phase, or, when trained on mixed terrains without separating recovery and locomotion phases or per-surface constraints, collapse to a single compromise get-up across surfaces. We propose Phase--Terrain Decoupled Learning (PTDL), which decouples training supervision along phase and terrain axes while deploying one proprioceptive policy. On the phase axis, projected-gravity-gated dual motion-prior discriminators and a probe-to-walk transition link post-fall recovery to commanded walking. On the terrain axis, terrain-stratified recovery shaping assigns surface-specific training supervision on flat ground, gravel, and slopes; terrain labels are training-only and withheld from policy observations, enabling implicit post-fall strategy selection at deployment. We validate PTDL on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 across flat ground, gravel, and slopes up to 20 degrees in simulation and on hardware, achieving stable cross-terrain recovery, smooth recovery-to-locomotion transitions, and differentiated post-fall rise behaviors under one deployed policy.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人在非结构化环境中可能在斜坡、碎石路及不平整地面上摔倒。我们致力于实现跌倒恢复与运动的一体化：仅利用本体感知从跌倒状态重建平衡，并在跌倒原地恢复速度指令行走。现有方法往往止步于准静态起身，忽略跌倒后的地面接触阶段，或者在混合地形上训练时未分离恢复阶段与运动阶段或每类地形的专属约束，最终退化为跨地形的单一妥协起身动作。我们提出阶段—地形解耦学习（PTDL），该方法沿阶段轴和地形轴解耦训练监督，同时部署单一本体感知策略。在阶段轴上，投影重力门控的双运动先验判别器与探测到行走的过渡机制将跌倒后恢复与指令行走相衔接；在地形轴上，分层地形恢复塑形为平地、碎石路和斜坡分别分配地形专属训练监督——地形标签仅用于训练且不对策略观测开放，从而在部署时实现隐式跌倒后策略选择。我们在29自由度Unitree G1机器人上，针对平地、碎石路及最大20度斜坡进行仿真与硬件验证，通过单一部署策略实现了稳定的跨地形恢复、平滑的恢复到运动过渡以及差异化的跌倒后起身行为。

Authors: Xiaoyu Xu, Zhiming Chen, Yuenan Zhao, Ran Song, Wei Zhang

Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks WorldModel

object-centric world model diffusion policy multi-stage robotic manipulation model predictive control subgoal planning

简要说明：WorldDP 提出了一个分层框架，将对象为中心的世界模型与扩散策略相结合，以处理多阶段机器人操作任务，优于现有基线。

TLDR: WorldDP introduces a hierarchical framework that combines an object-centric world model with diffusion policy to handle multi-stage robotic manipulation tasks, outperforming existing baselines.

Abstract: Visual world models have shown great potential in learning complex system dynamics. Recent advancements leverage these models as transition functions within Model Predictive Control (MPC) frameworks to solve various control tasks. When applied to robotics, however, they are limited to single-stage tasks such as reaching or grasping, and struggle with multi-stage ones that demand complex sequential planning. In this work, we introduce WorldDP, a world model framework designed for multi-stage robotic manipulation. Our hierarchical approach utilizes a high-level world model as a transition function to optimize for feasible subgoals during runtime, which are subsequently reached by a low-level Diffusion Policy. To further aid in learning dynamics and planning, we incorporate object-centric representations that decouple environmental entities and enable us to plan sequentially with respect to each. Evaluated across several robotics benchmarks, WorldDP consistently outperforms existing baselines, validating that coupling the world model's physically grounded planning with diffusion policy's efficient execution yields superior multi-stage performance.

摘要（中文）：视觉世界模型在学习复杂系统动力学方面展现出巨大潜力。近期研究将这些模型作为模型预测控制框架中的转移函数，用于解决各类控制任务。然而在机器人应用中，这些模型仅限于执行到达或抓取等单阶段任务，难以应对需要复杂序列规划的多阶段任务。为此，我们提出WorldDP——一种面向多阶段机器人操作的世界模型框架。该分层方法采用高层世界模型作为转移函数，在运行时优化可行的子目标，再由低层扩散策略完成子目标的执行。为辅助动力学学习与规划，我们引入以物体为中心的表征方法，将环境实体解耦，从而支持对各实体的顺序规划。在多个机器人基准测试中的评估表明，WorldDP持续超越现有基线模型，验证了将世界模型的物理基础规划与扩散策略的高效执行相结合，能够显著提升多阶段任务表现。

Authors: Raktim Gautam Goswami, Prashanth Krishnamurthy, Yann LeCun, Farshad Khorrami

FF-JEPA: Long-Horizon Planning in World Models with Latent Planners WorldModel

hierarchical world model latent planner long-horizon planning Forward-Forward-JEPA subgoal planning

简要说明：FF-JEPA 提出了一种分层世界模型，通过无动作的潜在规划器将长期任务分解为短期子目标，无需目标图像并缓解了长期规划崩溃问题。

TLDR: FF-JEPA proposes a hierarchical world model with an action-free latent planner to decompose long-horizon tasks into short-horizon subgoals, eliminating the need for goal images and mitigating long-horizon planning collapse.

Abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have shown promising world modeling capabilities, enabling planning in latent space by optimizing action trajectories using methods like the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). These methods are, however, too computationally expensive and ineffective for long-horizon planning. Furthermore, these methods typically require an explicit image of the goal state, which is not always possible in real-world tasks. In this work, we tackle these limitations by proposing Forward-Forward-JEPA (FF-JEPA), a hierarchical approach leveraging two forward dynamics models. Alongside a standard action-conditioned forward model, we introduce an action-free latent planner that predicts the next subgoal given the current state. This approach removes the need for goal images and enables long-horizon planning by decomposing complex trajectories into a sequence of tractable, short-term optimization problems. Preliminary results on PushT demonstrate that FF-JEPA successfully overcomes flat world models' long-horizon collapse, highlighting this approach as a promising direction for goal-free planning.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）已展现出良好的世界建模能力，能够通过交叉熵方法（CEM）等优化动作轨迹，在潜空间中进行规划。然而，这些方法计算成本过高，且对于长时域规划效果不佳。此外，此类方法通常需要目标状态的显式图像，这在现实任务中往往难以实现。针对这些局限，本文提出了一种分层方法——前向-前向-JEPA（FF-JEPA），该方法利用两个前向动力学模型。在标准动作条件前向模型的基础上，我们引入了一个无动作的潜规划器，能够根据当前状态预测下一个子目标。这一方法消除了对目标图像的需求，并通过将复杂轨迹分解为一系列可处理的短期优化问题，实现了长时域规划。在PushT任务上的初步结果表明，FF-JEPA成功克服了扁平世界模型在长时域规划中的崩溃问题，凸显了该方法在无目标规划中的潜力。

Authors: Sergi Masip, Jonathan Swinnen, Yutong Hu, Renaud Detry, Tinne Tuytelaars

Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models WorldModel

action-conditioned world models memory mechanisms video diffusion state-space recurrence open-domain return

简要说明：Echo-Memory 在动作条件世界模型中对记忆机制进行了受控研究，隔离了容量、压缩、读出和循环四个维度，在共享视频扩散骨干下发现块级状态空间循环在开放域返回中表现最佳。

TLDR: Echo-Memory presents a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models, isolating capacity, compression, read-out, and recurrence under a shared video diffusion backbone, and showing that block-wise state-space recurrence yields the best open-domain return.

Abstract: We present \textbf{Echo-Memory}, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. This matched matrix separates four otherwise conflated axes: \emph{capacity}, \emph{compression}, \emph{read-out}, and \emph{recurrence}. We also evaluate memory through a three-branch protocol: replay quality, in-domain loop revisit, and open-domain return probes. The branches routinely disagree, showing that replay fidelity is not a sufficient proxy for remembering a world. Three findings follow. Raw context is a strong capacity baseline and improves open-domain return far more than it improves replay metrics. Compactness is not a free substitute for capacity: aggressive spatial and hybrid-compression memories lose the salient evidence needed for return. Finally, block-wise state-space recurrence is the strongest open-domain return mechanism in our matrix, showing that the structure of implicit memory matters as much as the decision to use it. These results provide a compact protocol for studying memory in action world models beyond isolated replay metrics.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了**Echo-Memory**，一项关于动作条件世界模型中记忆机制的受控研究。这类模型根据首帧、文本提示和相机动作序列生成多片段视频，但其核心缺陷往往在于记忆而非局部图像合成：当相机离开并返回后，场景或显著物体可能发生静默变化。现有记忆设计难以比较，因为性能提升常与主干网络、训练方式、检索机制及评估指标的差异纠缠在一起。Echo-Memory固定了动作到视频的接口，仅改变生成器对历史信息的存储与读取方式。在共享的视频扩散主干、优化器、相机动作表征、采样器及评估流程下，我们比较了原始上下文、基于压缩的记忆、不同读出路径的空间摘要以及状态空间递归。这种对比矩阵将四个原本混淆的维度分离开来：**容量**、**压缩**、**读出**和**递归**。我们还通过三分支协议评估记忆：回放质量、域内循环重访和开放域返回探测。这三个分支的结果往往不一致，表明回放保真度并不足以作为世界记忆的代理指标。由此得出三项发现。原始上下文是一个强大的容量基线，其对开放域返回的提升远高于对回放指标的改善。紧凑性并非容量的免费替代品：激进的混合压缩记忆会丢失返回任务所需的显著证据。最后，分块状态空间递归是我们矩阵中最强的开放域返回机制，这表明隐式记忆的结构与是否使用记忆同样重要。这些结果为在动作世界模型中研究记忆提供了一种超越孤立回放指标的紧凑协议。

Authors: Wayne King, Zeyue Xue, Yuxuan Bian, Jie Huang, Haoran Li, Yaowei Li, Yaofeng Su, Yuming Li, Haoyu Wang, Shiyi Zhang, Songchun Zhang, Yuwei Niu, Sihan Xu, Junhao Zhuang, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan

Driving Video Retrieval for Complex Queries with Structured Grounding AutonomousDriving

video retrieval autonomous driving structured grounding rule adaptation weakly labeled data

简要说明：STRIVE-D 是一个针对驾驶视频的数据校准检索框架，利用弱标注域内数据调整规则查询，并与视觉语言及关键词信号融合，在驾驶事件检索基准上取得显著提升。

TLDR: STRIVE-D is a data-calibrated retrieval framework for driving videos that adapts rule-based event queries using weakly labeled in-domain data and fuses them with vision-language and keyword-based signals, achieving large gains on driving event retrieval benchmarks.

Abstract: Video retrieval at scale is central to data curation and safety validation in autonomous driving, where users want to find not only scenes but also dynamic events such as cut-ins and hard braking. Existing vision-language and keyword-based retrieval methods often miss these events because the relevant motion may not be explicitly described in text or captured by lexical overlap. Rule-based retrieval can encode such events more directly, but it is brittle: generated or hand-written rules often fail when their assumptions do not match real driving data. We propose STRIVE-D, a data-calibrated retrieval framework for driving videos. It uses weakly labeled in-domain videos to estimate when a query rule is reliable, adapt rules that mismatch observed data, and fuse calibrated rule scores with vision-language and keyword-based retrieval signals. Across three driving benchmarks, including newly released human-annotated event data on DrivingDojo, STRIVE-D delivers up to 84% relative improvement in top-1 accuracy over state-of-the-art methods.

摘要（中文）：在自动驾驶领域，大规模视频检索对于数据整理与安全验证至关重要，用户不仅希望检索到场景信息，还希望找到诸如切入、急刹车等动态事件。现有的基于视觉-语言和关键词的检索方法常常遗漏这些事件，原因在于相关运动可能未在文本中明确描述，或无法通过词汇重叠捕获。基于规则的检索虽能更直接地编码此类事件，但其存在脆弱性：当规则假设与真实驾驶数据不符时，生成或手动编写的规则往往会失效。我们提出STRIVE-D，一种面向驾驶视频的数据校准检索框架。该框架利用弱标注的领域内视频估计查询规则的可靠性，修正与观测数据不匹配的规则，并将校准后的规则得分与视觉-语言及关键词检索信号进行融合。在三个驾驶基准测试上（包括新发布的DrivingDojo人工标注事件数据），STRIVE-D在Top-1准确率上相较于现有最优方法实现了最高达84%的相对提升。

Authors: Manyi Yao, Sparsh Garg, Christian Shelton, Amit Roy-Chowdhury, Abhishek Aich

Difference-Aware Retrieval Policies for Imitation Learning Manipulation

semi-parametric imitation learning retrieval-based behavior cloning k-nearest neighbors

简要说明：DARP是一种半参数模仿学习方法，在推理时通过k近邻和相对距离重用训练数据，在连续控制和机器人操作中持续优于标准行为克隆。

TLDR: DARP is a semi-parametric imitation learning method that reuses training data at inference via k-nearest neighbors and relative distances, consistently outperforming standard behavior cloning in continuous control and robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Parametric imitation learning via behavior cloning can suffer from poor generalization to out-of-distribution states due to compounding errors during deployment. We show that reusing the training data during inference via a semi-parametric retrieval-based imitation learning approach can alleviate this challenge. We present Difference-Aware Retrieval Policies for Imitation Learning (DARP), a semi-parametric retrieval-based imitation learning approach that addresses this limitation by reparameterizing the imitation learning problem in terms of local neighborhood structure rather than direct state-to-action mappings. Instead of learning a global policy, DARP trains a model to predict actions based on $k$-nearest neighbors from expert demonstrations, their corresponding actions, and the relative distance vectors between neighbor states and query states. DARP requires no additional assumptions beyond those made for standard behavior cloning -- it does not require additional data collection, online expert feedback, or task-specific knowledge. We demonstrate consistent performance improvements of 15-46% over standard behavior cloning across diverse domains, including continuous control and robotic manipulation, and across different representations, including high-dimensional visual features. Code and demos are available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/darp-site/.

摘要（中文）：通过行为克隆的参数化模仿学习在部署过程中因误差累积，容易导致对分布外状态的泛化能力不足。我们证明，在推理阶段通过半参数化检索式模仿学习方法重用训练数据可以缓解这一挑战。本文提出面向模仿学习的差分感知检索策略（DARP），这是一种基于半参数化检索的模仿学习方法，通过将模仿学习问题从直接的状态到动作映射重新参数化为局部邻域结构，从而克服上述局限性。DARP不学习全局策略，而是训练一个模型，基于专家演示中的k近邻状态、对应的动作以及邻域状态与查询状态之间的相对距离向量来预测动作。DARP不需要在标准行为克隆的假设之外额外添加任何条件——无需额外数据收集、在线专家反馈或任务特定知识。我们在包括连续控制与机器人操作在内的多个领域，以及包括高维视觉特征在内的多种表征方式中，均证明其相比标准行为克隆可获得15-46%的持续性能提升。代码与演示可见于 https://weirdlabuw.github.io/darp-site/。

Authors: Quinn Pfeifer, Ethan Pronovost, Paarth Shah, Khimya Khetarpal, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Abhishek Gupta

Efficient Minimal Solvers for Relative Pose Estimation in Autonomous Driving Applications AutonomousDriving

relative pose estimation efficient minimal solvers autonomous driving multi-camera systems RANSAC

简要说明：本文提出了一个统一的框架和三种高效的相对位姿估计最小求解器，专门为实时自动驾驶应用设计。

TLDR: This paper proposes a unified framework and three efficient minimal solvers for relative pose estimation in multi-camera systems, specifically designed for real-time autonomous driving applications.

Abstract: With the advancement of visual sensing systems, computer vision is playing an increasingly important role in autonomous driving and robot navigation. Relative pose estimation in multi-camera systems is essential for accurate vehicle localization and environment perception, demanding high real-time performance and robustness. Existing methods, however, often involve high computational costs and rely heavily on abundant feature matches, limiting their applicability in time-sensitive driving scenarios. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a unified framework for efficient relative pose estimation, built upon a novel translation parameterization and first-order rotation approximation. Within this framework, we propose three efficient minimal solvers specifically designed for autonomous vehicles. The first solver integrates the vertical direction prior from Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), the second utilizes the rotation axis direction prior during steering maneuvers, and the third is designed for planar motion - a realistic assumption for ground vehicles operating on structured roads. By reducing both the minimal number of point correspondences and the algebraic complexity, our methods enable faster hypothesis generation within RANSAC-based pipelines, improving suitability for real-time systems. Extensive experiments on synthetic datasets and the KITTI autonomous driving benchmark demonstrate that the proposed solvers achieve a favorable balance between speed and accuracy compared to existing state-of-the-art algorithms.

摘要（中文）：随着视觉传感系统的发展，计算机视觉在自动驾驶和机器人导航中发挥着日益重要的作用。多相机系统中的相对位姿估计对于精确的车辆定位与环境感知至关重要，且对高实时性与鲁棒性提出了要求。然而，现有方法通常计算成本较高，且高度依赖充足的特征匹配，限制了其在时间敏感的驾驶场景中的适用性。为解决这些局限，本文提出了一种基于新型平移参数化与一阶旋转近似的统一框架，用于实现高效的相对位姿估计。在该框架下，我们设计了三种针对自动驾驶车辆的高效最小求解器。第一种求解器融合了惯性测量单元（IMU）提供的垂直方向先验信息，第二种求解器在转向操作中利用了旋转轴方向先验，第三种求解器则针对平面运动——这一地面车辆在结构化道路上运行时的真实假设而设计。通过减少点对应最小数量和代数复杂度，我们的方法能在基于RANSAC的管线中实现更快的假设生成，从而提升对实时系统的适应性。在合成数据集与KITTI自动驾驶基准上的大量实验表明，与现有最优算法相比，所提出的求解器在速度与精度之间实现了良好的平衡。

Authors: Tao Li, Liang Liu, Jianli Han, Weimin Lv

Goal Sets, Not Goal States: Queryable Robot Goals through Goal-Set Hindsight Relabeling RLRobot

hindsight relabeling goal-conditioned RL offline RL predicate-level generalization goal interface

简要说明：目标集事后重新标注（GS-HER）将HER泛化为使用二进制查询定义的谓词来指定目标集，在完整状态目标因干扰维度而过约束时，改善了离线目标条件强化学习的性能。

TLDR: Goal-Set Hindsight Relabeling (GS-HER) generalizes HER by using binary query-defined predicates to specify goal sets, improving offline goal-conditioned RL when full-state goals are overconstrained by nuisance dimensions.

Abstract: Hindsight relabeling usually turns achieved future states into exact goals, which can overconstrain offline robot learning when task success depends only on a subset of the state. We propose Goal-Set Hindsight Relabeling (GS-HER), a predicate-level generalization of HER in which achieved states certify query-defined goal sets rather than singleton goal states. A binary query specifies which variables define success, making the goal predicate an inference-time input while leaving the underlying offline GCRL algorithm unchanged. Across OGBench tasks and five offline goal-conditioned learners, GS-HER improves performance when full-state goals are bottlenecked by nuisance dimensions and turns hindsight relabeling into a reusable goal interface: one checkpoint can answer multiple robot goal predicates without retraining.

摘要（中文）：后见重标记通常将已实现的未来状态转化为精确目标，当任务成功仅依赖于状态子集时，这会过度约束离线机器人学习。我们提出目标集后见重标记（GS-HER），这是一种谓词级别的HER泛化方法，其中已实现状态认证的是查询定义的目标集，而非单一目标状态。二元查询指定了哪些变量定义成功，使目标谓词成为推理时的输入，同时保持底层离线GCRL算法不变。在OGBench任务及五种离线目标条件学习器上，GS-HER在完整状态目标受冗余维度瓶颈限制时提升了性能，并将后见重标记转化为可复用的目标接口：单个检查点无需重新训练即可响应多种机器人目标谓词。
