Authors: Carlos Vélez García, Miguel Cazorla, Jorge Pomares

Dense Force Estimation with an Event-based Optical Tactile Sensor Manipulation

event-based tactile sensor dense force estimation inverse finite elements method marker tracking dexterous manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了首个基于事件相机的光学触觉传感器密集三维力场重建框架，结合事件驱动的标记点跟踪算法和卷积神经网络，实现高频高精度力反馈，服务于机器人灵巧操作。

TLDR: This paper proposes the first framework for dense 3D force field reconstruction using an event-based optical tactile sensor, combining event-based marker tracking for shear displacement and a CNN for normal displacement, achieving accurate high-frequency force feedback for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Humans rely on spatially dense, geometry and force-aware tactile feedback at high temporal resolution for dexterous manipulation. While vision-based tactile sensors enable dense force estimation, they are limited by camera frame rates, motion blur, and data bandwidth. Event-based optical tactile sensors offer an attractive alternative with microsecond temporal resolution and low motion blur, but existing methods are restricted to predicting only net forces. We introduce the first framework for dense 3D force field reconstruction using event-based optical tactile sensors. Our approach estimates 3D surface displacements from event data and maps them to forces via the inverse Finite Elements Method (iFEM). Shear displacements are recovered through the proposed event-based marker tracking algorithm, while normal displacements are predicted by a convolutional neural network trained on a collected dataset of synchronized force-displacement-event data. Experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction of physically grounded forces, achieving a mean absolute error of (0.14 N, 0.10 N, 0.93 N) over force ranges up to (4 N, 4 N, 20 N), while operating at an average of 100 Hz. This work constitutes a first step toward enabling dense force feedback for high-frequency control in robotic grasping and dexterous manipulation.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 人类依靠高空间密度、几何与力觉感知的触觉反馈，以高时间分辨率完成灵巧操作。基于视觉的触觉传感器虽能实现密集力估计，但受限于相机帧率、运动模糊与数据带宽。基于事件的触觉传感器具有微秒级时间分辨率与低运动模糊的优势，但现有方法仅能预测净力。本文提出首个基于事件式光触传感器实现三维力场密集重建的框架。该方法从事件数据中估计三维表面位移，并通过逆有限元法将其映射为力。剪切位移通过所提出的事件式标记追踪算法恢复，法向位移则由卷积神经网络预测，该网络基于同步力-位移-事件数据集训练而成。实验表明，该方法可精确重建物理接触力，在力范围达（4 N, 4 N, 20 N）时，平均绝对误差为（0.14 N, 0.10 N, 0.93 N），且运行频率平均达100 Hz。本工作为在机器人抓取与灵巧操作中实现高频控制所需的密集力反馈迈出了第一步。

Authors: Agis Politis, René Zurbrügg, Valentina Cavinato

Harness Engineering for Physical AI: Robot Middleware Is the Harness Layer Other

robot middleware harness layer Physical AI ROS 2 VLA models

简要说明：本文提出机器人中间件应作为物理AI的‘适配层’，通过投影、隔离和转移三种新功能，对学习策略和VLA模型执行时序、资源和输出约束。

TLDR: This paper proposes that robot middleware should function as a 'harness' layer for Physical AI, enforcing timing, resource, and output constraints for learned policies and VLA models via three novel functions: Projection, Isolation, and Transfer.

Abstract: Robot middleware faces a new role in the era of Physical AI. Learned policies, planners, and vision-language-action (VLA) models now enter deployed robots as causal participants on the control path, but the layer that integrates them with timing, scheduling, and network has not been named. Recent language-agent work names this layer the harness, the external system that mediates tools, manages state, bounds resources, and records execution. The robotics community has not yet adopted this framing, and we propose that robot middleware is that harness. A Physical AI harness differs from a software harness in where it intervenes. A software harness mediates at tool-call boundaries. A Physical AI harness must mediate at control, computing, and communication simultaneously, because a learned policy's output crosses all three: its commands shift the trajectory, its inference time shifts the schedule, and its payload shifts the bandwidth. Robot middleware is the lowest robot-stack layer with mediating abstractions over all three, so it is best positioned to compose their enforcement. It already provides most of what a harness needs but lacks the enforcement for an AI model. We name this missing enforcement as three functions: Projection gates each output at emission, Isolation bounds the model's execution and transmission slot, and Transfer falls back to a verified baseline when checks fail. Each appears today as hand-built application code in deployed robot systems, built on surfaces robot middleware already provides. Robot middleware should host them not as the best single-axis enforcer but as the layer that composes all three. We sketch this as a ROS 2 Harness Profile, a deployment artifact that carries an AI model's declared output region, inference budget, and operating regime while the middleware enforces them across ROS 2, DDS, and Zenoh.

摘要（中文）：机器人中间件在物理人工智能时代面临新的角色。习得策略、规划器以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如今作为控制路径上的因果参与者进入部署的机器人系统，但将它们与定时、调度和网络整合在一起的层次尚未被命名。近期关于语言代理的研究将这一层次称为“驾驭层”（harness），即协调工具、管理状态、约束资源并记录执行过程的外部系统。机器人社区尚未采纳这一框架，我们提议机器人中间件就是这种驾驭层。物理人工智能驾驭层与软件驾驭层的区别在于其干预位置：软件驾驭层在工具调用边界进行协调，而物理人工智能驾驭层必须在控制、计算和通信三个维度同时进行协调——因为习得策略的输出贯穿所有这三个维度：其指令改变轨迹，其推理时间改变调度，其数据载荷改变带宽。机器人中间件是机器人堆栈中最低层且能对三者提供协调抽象的层次，因此它最适合构建这三者的强制机制。它已具备驾驭层所需的大部分功能，但缺少针对人工智能模型的强制机制。我们将这一缺失的强制机制命名为三项功能：投射（Projection）在输出时对每个输出进行门控，隔离（Isolation）约束模型的执行与传输时隙，回退（Transfer）在检查失败时切换至已验证的基线方案。这些功能当前在已部署的机器人系统中表现为手工构建的应用代码，基于机器人中间件已提供的接口实现。机器人中间件不应仅作为最佳单轴强制器托管它们，而应作为组合这三者的层次。我们将其勾勒为ROS 2驾驭层配置文件（ROS 2 Harness Profile），这是一种部署构件，承载人工智能模型声明的输出区域、推理预算和运行模式，而中间件则通过ROS 2、DDS和Zenoh强制执行这些约束。

Authors: Sanghoon Lee, Jiyeong Chae, Kyung-Joon Park

Taming Perception Jitter: Uncertainty-Aware LiDAR Object Detection for Reliable Motion Classification AutonomousDriving

uncertainty-aware detection aleatoric uncertainty two-sample z-test motion classification LiDAR object detection

简要说明：本文提出了一种不确定性感知的LiDAR目标检测方法，通过向3D检测添加偶然不确定性估计并使用两样本z检验区分真实运动与感知抖动，从而减少自动驾驶中的虚假动态预测。

TLDR: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware LiDAR object detection method that augments 3D detection with aleatoric uncertainty estimates and uses a two-sample z-test to distinguish true motion from perception jitter, reducing false dynamic predictions in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Reliable motion classification is critical for autonomous driving, as false dynamic predictions of static objects can cascade into unnecessary planner interventions. Unstable bounding box predictions can lead to spurious velocity estimates in tracking and falsely predicted trajectories. We present a deployment-friendly mitigation strategy that augments a 3D object detector with aleatoric uncertainty estimates and applies a two-sample z-test over short observation windows to separate true motion from jitter. Integrated into Autoware with minimal changes, the approach reuses existing data association for minimal compute overhead. Empirical results show parity with velocity thresholding on nuScenes, but substantially fewer false dynamic predictions and unnecessary stops in real-world test drives, explained by the presence of an intermediate jitter band in the recorded data that speed-only rules misclassify. This demonstrates that uncertainty-aware detection and lightweight statistical testing can deliver practical performance gains for autonomous driving in noisier real-world settings.

摘要（中文）：可靠的运动分类对于自动驾驶至关重要，因为对静态物体的错误动态预测可能引发不必要的规划器干预。不稳定的边界框预测会导致跟踪中出现虚假的速度估计以及错误预测的运动轨迹。我们提出了一种易于部署的缓解策略，通过为3D物体检测器增加偶然不确定性估计，并在短时间观测窗口内应用双样本z检验，以区分真实运动与抖动。该策略仅需对Autoware进行最小改动即可集成，通过复用现有数据关联实现极低的计算开销。实验结果表明，在nuScenes数据集上，该方法的性能与速度阈值法相当，但在真实道路测试中，错误动态预测和不必要停车的次数显著减少——这是因为记录数据中存在一种速度规则无法正确分类的中间抖动带。这证明，不确定性感知检测与轻量级统计检验能够为噪声更大的真实驾驶场景带来实用的性能提升。

Authors: Cornelius Schröder, Žygimantas Marcinkus, Markus Lienkamp

KPGrasp: Scalable Keypoint Flow Matching for Dexterous Grasp Generation Manipulation

dexterous grasp generation flow matching hand-keypoint parameterization Transformer flow model keypoint flow matching

简要说明：KPGrasp采用流匹配框架，结合全欧几里得手部关键点参数化和Transformer流模型，从大规模数据生成灵巧抓取，无需基于接触的优化，在仿真和真实世界中均达到最优成功率。

TLDR: KPGrasp uses a flow-matching framework with an all-Euclidean hand-keypoint parameterization and a Transformer flow model to generate dexterous grasps from large-scale data, achieving state-of-the-art success rates in simulation and real-world deployment without contact-based refinement.

Abstract: Generating high-quality dexterous grasps remains challenging for learning-based methods, which often depend on carefully tuned contact losses or costly contact-based test-time refinement. We present KPGrasp, a flow-matching framework that learns dexterous grasp priors from large-scale data rather than relying on contact losses or contact-based test-time refinement. KPGrasp couples an all-Euclidean 3D hand-keypoint parameterization with a simple yet scalable Transformer flow model. The parameterization avoids the drawbacks of the conventional mixed SE(3) pose and joint-angle output space, expresses grasps in the same frame as the object point cloud, and thus enables native spatial reasoning; the Transformer flow model is trained with only the standard flow-matching loss and scales effectively with data, model capacity, and batch size. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on two simulation benchmarks. On the Dexonomy benchmark, it reaches a 76.3% grasp success rate, improving over the strongest directly comparable baseline by 47.4% while reducing penetration depth to 2.4 mm. The same model also achieves the best average performance on the DexGrasp Anything benchmark without fine-tuning. For batched inference, KPGrasp requires only 0.032 s per grasp. Finally, real-world experiments on 20 diverse objects demonstrate that the pipeline can be deployed in a real-world setup.

摘要（中文）：生成高质量灵巧抓取对于基于学习的方法仍然具有挑战性，这类方法通常依赖精细调节的接触损失或高成本的基于接触的测试时优化。我们提出KPGrasp——一种流匹配框架，从大规模数据中学习灵巧抓取先验，而非依赖接触损失或基于接触的测试时优化。KPGrasp将全欧几里得三维手部关键点参数化与简单且可扩展的Transformer流模型相结合。该参数化避免了传统混合SE(3)位姿与关节角度输出空间的缺陷，在与物体点云相同的坐标系中表示抓取，从而实现了原生空间推理；Transformer流模型仅使用标准流匹配损失进行训练，并能随数据、模型容量和批处理规模有效扩展。实验表明，该方法在两个仿真基准上达到最优性能。在Dexonomy基准上，其抓取成功率达76.3%，相比最强直接可比基线提升47.4%，同时将穿透深度降至2.4毫米。同一模型无需微调便在DexGrasp Anything基准上取得最佳平均性能。批处理推理时，KPGrasp每个抓取仅需0.032秒。最后，在20种不同物体上的真实世界实验证明，该流程可部署于实际场景。

Authors: Yuansen Huang, Jiayi Chen, Haoran Liu, Yubin Ke, Bing Han, Jiangran Lyu, Mi Yan, Li Yi, He Wang

VGP-Nav: Metric-Aware Visual Geometric Perception for Robot Navigation VLN

monocular navigation metric localization obstacle perception ground-plane geometry scale ambiguity

简要说明：VGP-Nav是一个仅依赖单目RGB的框架，通过地面几何约束解决尺度模糊性，实现度量感知的视觉几何感知，无需激光雷达即可同时支持全局定位和密集障碍物感知。

TLDR: VGP-Nav is a monocular RGB-only framework that achieves metric-aware visual geometric perception for robot navigation by using ground-plane geometry to resolve scale ambiguity, enabling both global localization and dense obstacle perception without LiDAR.

Abstract: Reliable robotic navigation necessitates the seamless integration of accurate global localization and dense, metric-consistent obstacle perception. A common strategy to achieve these capabilities involves integrating diverse sensing modalities: cameras offer rich visual features for localization, while active sensors like LiDAR provide direct metric measurements. However, such multi-sensor configurations necessitate complex spatial-temporal calibration and increase deployment overhead. Although vision-only approaches offer a low-cost and scalable alternative, existing monocular visual systems typically struggle to simultaneously achieve efficient, globally consistent localization and dense, metric-consistent geometric perception. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{VGP-Nav}, a unified framework for \textit{Metric-Aware Visual Geometric Perception} that relies solely on monocular RGB input to jointly support metric localization and obstacle perception. Our key insight is to anchor localization-grounded visual geometry to physically meaningful scale constraints derived from ground-plane geometry, thereby providing a reliable metric reference for monocular perception. VGP-Nav resolves monocular scale ambiguity online and produces localization-grounded, metric obstacle representations that are directly applicable to downstream planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong generalization across diverse environments and successful deployment on real mobile robots, highlighting the practicality of our approach for scalable, low-cost, and safe autonomous navigation.

摘要（中文）：可靠机器人导航需要精确全局定位与稠密、尺度一致的障碍物感知的无缝融合。实现这些能力的常见策略是集成多种传感模态：相机提供丰富的视觉特征用于定位，而激光雷达等主动传感器提供直接的度量测量。然而，这类多传感器配置需要复杂的时空标定，且增加了部署开销。尽管纯视觉方案提供了低成本、可扩展的替代方案，但现有单目视觉系统通常难以同时实现高效的全局一致定位与稠密、尺度一致的几何感知。为弥合这一差距，我们提出\textbf{VGP-Nav}——一个统一的\textit{度量感知视觉几何感知}框架，仅依赖单目RGB输入即可联合支持度量定位与障碍物感知。我们的核心洞察在于将基于定位的视觉几何锚定到源于地平面几何的物理意义尺度约束上，从而为单目感知提供可靠的度量参考。VGP-Nav在线解决单目尺度歧义问题，并生成可直接应用于下游规划的、基于定位的度量障碍物表征。大量实验证明了其在多样化环境中的强泛化能力及在真实移动机器人上的成功部署，凸显了该方法对可扩展、低成本且安全自主导航的实用性。

Authors: Hewei Pan, Weiye Zhu, Zekai Zhang, Zitong Huang, Rongtao Xu, Jinbao Wang, Feng Zheng

Autonomous Obstacle Removal for Excavators through Policy Learning with Particle Simulation Manipulation

policy learning particle simulation curriculum learning sim-to-real excavator

简要说明：提出一种基于埋深条件课程学习的框架，利用粒子仿真训练挖掘机自主移除障碍的策略，并成功迁移到12吨真实挖掘机上。

TLDR: Proposes a burial-conditioned curriculum learning framework that uses particle simulation to train an excavator policy for autonomous obstacle removal, achieving successful sim-to-real transfer on a 12-ton excavator.

Abstract: Autonomous obstacle removal from the ground is an important earthwork task, but this is difficult to automate because an excavator must adapt its excavation trajectories over repeated cycles as soil-obstacle conditions change. Learning such state-dependent behavior requires a training environment that reproduces accumulated soil-obstacle interactions, including contact states, terrain deformation, and obstacle visibility. Accordingly, particle-based simulation is suitable for the relevant policy learning. However, particle simulation is computationally expensive, and repeated excavation cycles further increase the learning cost. We observe that the burial condition of an obstacle governs both task difficulty and simulation cost: deeper burial makes obstacle removal harder while also requiring more particles for accurate simulation. This observation motivates a burial-conditioned curriculum learning strategy. We propose a time-efficient sim-to-real policy learning framework in which the policy observes terrain and obstacle information from RGB-D measurements and then outputs a parameterized excavation trajectory; in this process, the simulator reproduces in a real-world excavator the same observation-action interface it uses under controllable burial conditions. The curriculum begins with shallow burial conditions and progressively increases burial depth while adjusting particle count, thus simultaneously controlling task difficulty and simulation cost. Experiments show that the proposed framework successfully learns an effective obstacle-removal policy, whereas baseline methods fail even after a full week of training. The proposed curriculum achieves effective performance within three days and achieves successful transfer to a real 12-ton excavator operating on open ground with various steel obstacles, thus demonstrating robust obstacle removal.

摘要（中文）：自主清除地面障碍物是一项重要的土方工程任务，但由于挖掘机必须随着土壤-障碍物条件变化而反复调整其挖掘轨迹，因此自动化实现难度较大。学习此类状态依赖行为需要能够重现累积的土壤-障碍物相互作用（包括接触状态、地形变形及障碍物可见性）的训练环境。因此，基于粒子的模拟适用于相关策略学习。然而，粒子模拟计算成本高昂，而重复的挖掘循环进一步增加了学习代价。我们观察到障碍物的掩埋状况同时决定了任务难度与模拟成本：掩埋越深，障碍物清除越困难，同时需要更多粒子来实现精确模拟。这一发现促使我们提出基于掩埋条件的分阶段学习策略。我们构建了一种高效的从仿真到现实的策略学习框架，在该框架中，策略通过RGB-D测量数据获取地形与障碍物信息，并输出参数化的挖掘轨迹；在此过程中，模拟器在可控掩埋条件下复现了真实挖掘机所采用的观测-动作接口。课程学习从浅层掩埋条件开始，逐步增加掩埋深度并同步调整粒子数量，从而同时控制任务难度与模拟成本。实验表明，所提框架成功学习了有效的障碍物清除策略，而基线方法即使经过整周训练仍无法成功。所提出的课程学习方法可在三天内达到有效性能，并成功迁移至在开阔场地上作业的12吨真实挖掘机（面对多种钢制障碍物），展现出鲁棒的障碍物清除能力。

Authors: Yuki Kadokawa, Sandro M. Alcantara Tacora, Taro Abe, Daisuke Endo, Genki Yamauchi, Takeshi Hashimoto, Takamitsu Matsubara

Autonomous FPV Flight with Translational Optical Flow and Uncertainty Mask RLRobot

translational optical flow uncertainty mask autonomous FPV flight differentiable simulation obstacle avoidance

简要说明：本文提出一种仅使用平移光流与不确定性掩码的自主FPV四旋翼飞行系统，通过可微分仿真训练，在复杂环境中实现高速鲁棒避障。

TLDR: This paper presents an autonomous FPV quadrotor flight system that uses only translational optical flow and an uncertainty mask to achieve robust obstacle avoidance at high speeds in complex environments, trained via differentiable simulation.

Abstract: Autonomous FPV quadrotor flight in complex environments using a monocular RGB camera as the sole exteroceptive sensor remains a fundamental challenge. Recent research has shown that using optical flow as the input of a neural network can achieve end-to-end autonomous flight in cluttered scenes. However, extracting the most relevant information from the flow estimation is the key bottleneck limiting agility and robustness. Existing methods struggle to disentangle obstacle-induced optical flow from the ego-motion background flow and suffer from low signal-to-noise ratios near the focus of expansion (FoE). To address these issues, we decompose the optical flow into translational and rotational components and utilize only the translational flow, which captures scene geometry and depth cues. In addition, we introduce an uncertainty mask derived from inconsistencies between forward and backward flow estimates. This mask highlights obstacle structures, including those within the FoE region. Both cues are fed to a control policy trained in a differentiable simulation framework, which enables efficient first-order optimization across perception and control. We validate our approach through extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world forest environments. The proposed system achieves robust flight at speeds of up to 13.91 m/s in simulation and 11.79 m/s in real-world tests, with a 93.3\% success rate over 30 real-world trials, nearly doubling the previously reported 6 m/s real-world speed of the monocular-RGB optical-flow UAV obstacle avoidance system.

摘要（中文）：自主FPV四旋翼在复杂环境中仅依靠单目RGB相机作为外部传感器仍是一项根本性挑战。近年研究表明，将光流作为神经网络输入可在杂乱场景中实现端到端自主飞行。然而，从光流估计中提取最相关信息的环节仍是制约敏捷性与鲁棒性的关键瓶颈。现有方法难以将障碍物诱发的光流与自运动背景光流解耦，并在膨胀焦点（FoE）附近存在信噪比低的问题。针对这些问题，我们将光流分解为平移分量与旋转分量，仅利用包含场景几何与深度线索的平移流。此外，我们引入基于前向与后向光流估计不一致性的不确定性掩膜，该掩膜能突出显示障碍物结构（包括FoE区域内的障碍物）。将上述两个线索输入在可微分仿真框架中训练的控制策略，即可实现感知与控制跨环节的一阶优化。我们在仿真与真实森林环境中开展了大量实验验证：所提系统在仿真中最高以13.91米/秒速度实现鲁棒飞行，真实测试中达11.79米/秒，30次真实试验成功率达93.3%，近乎翻倍提升了此前单目RGB光流无人机避障系统报道的6米/秒真实飞行速度。

Authors: Yang Deng, Yu Hu, Feng Yu, Linzuo Zhang, Danping Zou

ATM: Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for Diagnosing and Improving Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models action-consistency planning diagnosis action-identifiability training lightweight evaluation

简要说明：提出ATM，一种轻量级诊断矩阵，无需昂贵的模拟器评估即可评估用于规划的潜在世界模型，并利用AITS将动作可识别性作为训练信号。

TLDR: Proposes ATM, a lightweight diagnostic matrix to evaluate latent world models for planning without expensive simulator rollouts, and AITS to use action-identifiability as a training signal.

Abstract: Latent world models are increasingly used for control and goal-conditioned planning, yet assessing whether their learned representations are useful for planning usually requires slow, planner-coupled simulator evaluation with CEM or similar planners. Such evaluation is black-box and model-complexity-dependent: under the same protocol, different world models may require minutes to hours per checkpoint. In this work, we propose ATM, an Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for diagnosing whether latent transitions preserve action semantics relevant to planning. ATM compares action information in real encoded transitions and model-predicted transitions through lightweight post-hoc probes, producing an interpretable matrix that reveals representation quality, transition-domain inconsistency, and failure modes without simulator rollout. It can also be collapsed into a simple screening score for within-task ranking across checkpoints, variants, and world models. When the true success gap is non-trivial, ATM achieves highly reliable pairwise ranking, while reducing minutes-to-hours CEM evaluation to seconds-level transition analysis, yielding more than 100x speedup in our setup. We further introduce AITS, showing that action-identifiability is not only diagnostic but also a useful training signal for improving downstream planning without changing the planner.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型越来越多地被用于控制和目标条件规划，然而评估其学习到的表征是否有助于规划通常需要使用CEM或类似规划器进行缓慢的、与规划器耦合的模拟器评估。此类评估是黑盒且依赖于模型复杂度的：在相同协议下，不同世界模型的每个检查点可能需花费数分钟至数小时进行评估。本文提出ATM（动作一致性迁移矩阵），用于诊断潜在状态迁移是否保留了与规划相关的动作语义。ATM通过轻量级事后探针比较真实编码迁移与模型预测迁移中的动作信息，生成一个可解释的矩阵，无需模拟器展开即可揭示表征质量、迁移域不一致性及失效模式。该矩阵还可简化为简单的筛选分数，用于跨检查点、变体及世界模型的同类任务排序。当真实成功率差异显著时，ATM能实现高度可靠的两两排序，同时将数分钟至数小时的CEM评估缩短至秒级迁移分析，在我们的设置中实现超过100倍的加速。我们进一步引入AITS，表明动作可识别性不仅具有诊断价值，还可作为有效的训练信号，在不改变规划器的情况下改进下游规划。

Authors: Jiaheng Chen

Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models on SO-101: Failure and Recovery Analysis VLA

VLA models robotic manipulation failure taxonomy recovery-aware evaluation low-cost robotic platform

简要说明：本文提出了一个标准化的真实世界基准SO-101，用于在低成本机器人平台上评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和模仿学习策略，重点分析失败分类和恢复能力指标。

TLDR: This paper introduces a standardized real-world benchmark, SO-101, for evaluating Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and imitation learning policies on a low-cost robotic platform, with a focus on failure taxonomy and recovery-aware metrics.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet existing evaluations are primarily conducted in simulation or on expensive robotic platforms, leaving their robustness on affordable real-world robots largely unexplored. We present a standardized real-world benchmark for evaluating representative VLA and imitation learning policies on the low-cost SO-101 robotic platform. The benchmark comprises four representative manipulation tasks together with unified evaluation protocols, enabling systematic comparison under embodiment uncertainty. Using real-world teleoperated demonstrations, we fine-tune and evaluate $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, Wall-X, and ACT directly on the physical platform. Beyond conventional task success rates, the benchmark incorporates a structured failure taxonomy, semantic- and execution-level failure decomposition, and recovery-aware evaluation metrics to characterize policy robustness. Experimental results show that stronger pretrained VLA policies generally outperform the imitation learning baseline, although performance remains highly task-dependent under low-cost robotic deployment conditions. Execution instability emerges as the dominant failure source, while recovery capability varies substantially across architectures. These results highlight the importance of failure and recovery analysis beyond binary task success and establish SO-101 as a practical benchmark for evaluating embodied AI systems under realistic low-cost robotic deployment conditions.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已在机器人操作任务中展现出强大的泛化能力，然而现有评估主要局限于仿真环境或昂贵的机器人平台，其在可负担的真实机器人上的鲁棒性仍存在大量空白。我们提出了一种标准化真实世界基准测试，用于在低成本SO-101机器人平台上评估代表性VLA策略与模仿学习策略。该基准涵盖四项典型操作任务及统一评估协议，可在具身不确定性条件下实现系统性比较。通过真实遥操作演示数据，我们直接在物理平台上微调并评估了$π_{0.5}$、SmolVLA、Wall-X和ACT算法。除传统任务成功率外，该基准还纳入结构化失败分类体系、语义级与执行级失败分解，以及可感知恢复能力的评估指标，以刻画策略鲁棒性。实验结果表明，预训练更强的VLA策略普遍优于模仿学习基线，但在低成本机器人部署条件下，性能仍高度依赖于具体任务。执行不稳定性是主要的失败来源，而不同架构的恢复能力存在显著差异。这些结果强调了超越二元任务成功率进行失败与恢复分析的重要性，并确立了SO-101作为在真实低成本机器人部署条件下评估具身AI系统的实用基准。

Authors: Yi Yu, Xinchuan Qiu

Geometry-Aware Fisheye-LiDAR Fusion for Robust 3D Object Detection in Low-Overlap Setups Perception3D

fisheye-LiDAR fusion geometry-aware hybrid fusion distortion-aware LSS dual-attention warping correction 3D object detection

简要说明：提出了一种几何感知融合框架（GA-HF），显式处理鱼眼相机畸变与LiDAR笛卡尔空间的不对齐问题，在低重叠、稀疏视角配置下实现鲁棒的3D目标检测。

TLDR: Proposes a geometry-aware fusion framework (GA-HF) that explicitly handles fisheye camera distortion and LiDAR-Cartesian misalignment for robust 3D object detection in low-overlap, sparse-view setups.

Abstract: As autonomous systems expand from capital-intensive robotaxis to cost-sensitive logistics, sensor configurations are increasingly optimized for coverage-per-cost. A prevalent sparse-view setup utilizes dual-fisheye cameras with a roof-mounted LiDAR, introducing severe geometric challenges: extreme radial distortion, minimal overlap, and misalignment between spherical projections and rectilinear grids. BEV fusion algorithms typically force image and point cloud modalities into unified Cartesian grids early in the pipeline, causing significant feature distortion and information loss for wide-view fisheye cameras. To address this, we propose a Geometry-Aware Hybrid Fusion (GA-HF) framework that explicitly accounts for fisheye geometry and BEV feature distortion, where fisheye features are lifted into a polar BEV grid via a Distortion-Aware Lift-Splat-Shoot (LSS) module to preserve native angular density, while LiDAR features are processed in native Cartesian space for metric fidelity of bounding box regression. To bridge these heterogeneous streams, we introduce a Dual-Attention Warping Correction module that applies spatial and channel attention to the warped camera features before fusion, explicitly suppressing artifacts in low-quality peripheral regions while enhancing high-quality semantic cues. GA-HF is evaluated on three benchmarks: KITTI-360, Dur360BEV, and Fisheye3DOD datasets. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first approach to explore LiDAR-fisheye camera fusion. On KITTI-360, GA-HF improves NDS by 4.2% over Cartesian baselines; on Dur360BEV, it surpasses both LiDAR-only and BEVFusion, while significantly reducing orientation error despite the geometric distortions; on Fisheye3DOD, it attains the highest detection score among all fusion methods.

摘要（中文）：随着自主系统从资本密集型的自动驾驶出租车扩展至成本敏感的物流领域，传感器配置日益朝着“单次覆盖成本”最优化的方向发展。一种常见的稀疏视野配置采用双鱼眼相机与车顶激光雷达的组合，由此引入了严峻的几何挑战：极端径向畸变、极小重叠区域，以及球面投影与直角网格之间的错位。鸟瞰视角融合算法通常在流程早期强制将图像与点云模态统一至笛卡尔网格，这导致宽视场鱼眼相机出现显著的特征畸变与信息损失。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种几何感知混合融合框架，该框架显式地考虑了鱼眼几何特性与鸟瞰视角特征畸变：通过畸变感知的Lift-Splat-Shoot模块将鱼眼特征提升至极坐标鸟瞰网格，从而保留原生角度密度；同时，激光雷达特征在原生笛卡尔空间中处理，以保证边界框回归的度量保真度。为桥接这两种异构数据流，我们引入了双重注意力变形校正模块，在融合前对变形后的相机特征施加空间与通道注意力机制，抑制低质量边缘区域的伪影，同时增强高质量语义线索。GA-HF在KITTI-360、Dur360BEV与Fisheye3DOD三个基准数据集上进行了评估。据我们所知，这是首个探索激光雷达与鱼眼相机融合的工作。在KITTI-360上，GA-HF相较笛卡尔基线方法将NDS指标提升了4.2%；在Dur360BEV上，它超越了仅使用激光雷达的方法与BEVFusion，并在几何畸变条件下显著降低了方向误差；在Fisheye3DOD上，它在所有融合方法中取得了最高的检测分数。

Authors: Xiangzhong Liu, Xihao Wang, Hao Shen

One Lens, Many Worlds : A Capability-Typed Interface for World-Model Interpretability WorldModel

world model interpretability capability-typed interface recurrent state-space model token-based model

简要说明：本文提出WorldModelLens，一种能力类型化的接口，通过定义少量必需方法和可选头部，统一了多种世界模型架构的可解释性方法。

TLDR: This paper presents WorldModelLens, a capability-typed interface that unifies interpretability methods across diverse world model architectures by defining a small set of required methods and optional heads.

Abstract: World models are now built on substantially different computational substrates. Latent recurrent state-space models such as PlaNet and the Dreamer family compress observations into recurrent states; token-based models such as IRIS quantize observations into a learned codebook and predict autoregressively with a transformer; and joint-embedding predictive architectures such as I-JEPA predict in a learned latent space with no pixel decoder. The interpretability methods applied to these models, including probing, activation patching, sparse autoencoders, and surprise analysis, share a common set of primitives, yet they are re-implemented from scratch for each architecture because existing hook-and-cache tooling assumes a transformer language model with no notion of actions, environment steps, or imagined rollouts. We argue that this fragmentation reflects the tooling rather than the models, and that the shared structure of world models is captured by a small typed interface. We present WorldModelLens, an open-source interpretability substrate organized around a capability-typed adapter: every model implements four required methods (encode, transition, initial state, sample) and declares a set of optional heads (decode, reward, continue, actor, critic) through an explicit capability descriptor, so that reinforcement-learning and self-supervised world models are first-class without either imitating the other. A single hook and cache layer exposes time-indexed activations, imagination rollouts, and intervention replay over this interface, allowing each analysis to be written once.

摘要（中文）：世界模型如今构建于截然不同的计算基底之上。PlaNet和Dreamer系列等潜在递归状态空间模型将观测压缩为递归状态；IRIS等基于令牌的模型将观测量化至学习的码本中，并利用Transformer进行自回归预测；I-JEPA等联合嵌入预测架构则在无像素解码器的学习潜空间中进行预测。应用于这些模型的可解释性方法（包括探针分析、激活修补、稀疏自编码器和惊奇分析）共享一套共同的原语，却需为每种架构重新实现，因为现有钩子与缓存工具假定的是无动作、环境步长或想象展开概念的Transformer语言模型。我们认为这种碎片化反映的是工具而非模型本身，世界模型的共享结构可通过一个小型类型化接口来捕捉。我们提出WorldModelLens——一个围绕能力类型化适配器组织的开源可解释性基础框架：每个模型实现四个必要方法（编码、转移、初始状态、采样），并通过显式能力描述符声明一组可选头部（解码、奖励、延续、行动者、评判者），使得强化学习与自监督世界模型无需相互模仿即可成为一等公民。单一钩子与缓存层在该接口上暴露时间索引激活值、想象展开与干预回放，使各分析模块得以一次性编写完成。

Authors: Bhavith Chandra Challagundla, Sanskar Pandey, Param Thakkar, Rishikesh Mallagundla, Yugandhar Reddy Gogireddy, Wenhao Lu, Hindol Roy Choudhury, Shravani Challagundla, Mohamed Deraz Nasr, Spursh Deshpande

Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models WorldModel

latent spatial memory video world model diffusion latent space depth-guided back-projection 3D cache

简要说明：Mirage 提出了一种用于视频世界模型的潜在空间记忆，将场景信息直接存储在扩散潜在空间中，消除了像素空间重建，实现了显著的速度和内存优化。

TLDR: Mirage introduces a latent spatial memory for video world models that stores scene information directly in diffusion latent space, eliminating pixel-space reconstruction and achieving significant speed and memory improvements.

Abstract: Video world models that maintain 3D spatial consistency across generated frames typically rely on explicit point cloud memory constructed in RGB space. This design is both computationally expensive, requiring repeated rendering and VAE encoding, and inherently lossy, as the round trip through pixel space discards rich features of the learned latent representation. In this paper, we introduce \emph{latent spatial memory} for video world models, a persistent 3D cache that stores scene information directly in the diffusion latent space, avoiding pixel-space reconstruction. Building on this, we propose Mirage, a latent-space spatial memory framework that constructs the memory by lifting latent tokens into 3D via depth-guided back-projection and queries it by synthesizing novel views through direct latent-space warping. This unified formulation eliminates both the information loss of pixel-space reconstruction and the computational burden of repeated encoding and rendering. Experiments show that latent spatial memory achieves up to \textbf{10.57}$\times$ faster end-to-end video generation and \textbf{55}$\times$ reduction in memory footprint relative to explicit 3D baselines. Leveraging the geometric prior of the diffusion model, Mirage attains state-of-the-art performance on WorldScore and strong reconstruction quality on RealEstate10K.

摘要（中文）：在生成帧间保持三维空间一致性的视频世界模型，通常依赖于在RGB空间中构建的显式点云内存。这种设计不仅计算成本高昂（需要反复进行渲染和VAE编码），而且本质上存在信息损失——由于往返于像素空间的过程会丢弃学习到的潜在表征中的丰富特征。本文提出用于视频世界模型的**潜在空间记忆**——一种直接在扩散潜在空间中存储场景信息的持久化三维缓存，从而避免像素空间重构。在此基础上，我们提出Mirage框架，这是一种潜在空间中的空间记忆架构：通过深度引导的反向投影将潜在令牌提升至三维空间来构建记忆，并通过直接在潜在空间中进行扭曲操作来合成新视角从而实现记忆查询。这种统一公式消除了像素空间重构的信息损失，同时避免了重复编码与渲染带来的计算负担。实验表明，相较于显式三维基线方法，潜在空间记忆实现了高达**10.57倍**的端到端视频生成加速，以及**55倍**的内存占用缩减。利用扩散模型的几何先验，Mirage在WorldScore基准上取得了最先进的性能，并在RealEstate10K数据集上展现出强大的重建质量。

Authors: Weijie Wang, Haoyu Zhao, Yifan Yang, Feng Chen, Zeyu Zhang, Yefei He, Zicheng Duan, Donny Y. Chen, Yuqing Yang, Bohan Zhuang

ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model WorldModel

generative 3D model 3D Gaussian Splatting satellite imagery sim-to-real UAV navigation

简要说明：ABot-Earth 0.5 是一个基于3D高斯泼溅的生成框架，能从卫星图像合成大规模无缝城市环境，支持闭环无人机导航等具身AI应用。

TLDR: ABot-Earth 0.5 is a generative 3D framework using 3D Gaussian Splatting to synthesize large-scale, seamless urban environments from satellite imagery, enabling embodied AI applications like closed-loop UAV navigation.

Abstract: We present ABot-Earth 0.5, a generative 3D framework designed to synthesize vast, seamless 3D environments from ubiquitous, geospatially referenced satellite imagery. To achieve this, we propose a novel generative model formulated directly with the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representation. The model is trained on a diverse corpus of existing real-world urban reconstructions, learning to generate realistic geometry and textures. At inference, it synthesizes novel 3D scenes conditioned solely on satellite imagery at a scalable rate of under 10 minutes per square kilometer, while demonstrating exceptional realism. The framework is designed for accessibility, with integrated hierarchical level-of-detail (LOD) structures that permit real-time, interactive visualization on web-based map engines. This high-fidelity simulation sandbox effectively mitigates the sim-to-real domain gap, enabling critical downstream Embodied AI applications like closed-loop UAV navigation. By providing an ultra-low-cost and high-efficiency solution, ABot-Earth 0.5 significantly lowers the technical and financial barriers to large-scale 3D reconstruction and empowers the future of global digital earth visualization.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了ABot-Earth 0.5，这是一个生成式三维框架，旨在从普遍存在的地理参考卫星影像中合成大规模、无缝的三维环境。为此，我们提出了一种直接基于三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）表示的新型生成模型。该模型在大量真实世界城市重建数据语料库上进行训练，学习生成逼真的几何结构与纹理。在推理阶段，它仅以卫星影像为条件，以每平方公里不到10分钟的可扩展速率合成新颖的三维场景，同时展现出卓越的真实感。该框架注重易用性，集成了分层细节层次（LOD）结构，可在基于Web的地图引擎上实现实时的交互式可视化。这一高保真模拟沙盒有效缩小了仿真到现实的领域差距，为闭环无人机导航等关键的具身智能下游应用提供了支持。通过提供超低成本与高效率的解决方案，ABot-Earth 0.5显著降低了大规模三维重建的技术与财务门槛，并推动了全球数字地球可视化的未来发展。

Where Does the Answer Come From? Benchmarking View-Level Visual Evidence Identification in Multi-View MLLMs for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

multi-view MLLM visual evidence grounding autonomous driving benchmark conflict-centric QA NuScenes

简要说明：提出了一个用于自动驾驶的多视图VQA基准，评估MLLM是否正确识别了支持性摄像头视角，揭示了仅凭答案评估无法发现的视觉依据错误。

TLDR: Introduces a multi-view VQA benchmark for autonomous driving that evaluates whether MLLMs correctly identify the supporting camera view, revealing grounding failures missed by answer-only evaluation.

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong results on visual reasoning benchmarks, but answer accuracy alone does not indicate whether a model relied on the correct visual evidence. This gap is particularly important in multi-view driving scenes used for autonomous driving, where a model can produce a plausible answer while grounding it in the wrong camera view. We introduce a multi-view visual question answering benchmark for evaluating evidence-source identification: given six synchronized NuScenes views and a question, the model must identify the supporting camera view and answer the question. The benchmark contains 122 conflict-centric question-answer pairs from 73 scenes, spanning causality, counterfactual reasoning, and intent prediction. View labels are proposed by an automatic conflict-mining pipeline and manually verified by annotators. We evaluate three settings: camera-view selection, oracle QA given the golden view, and joint prediction in which the model selects a view and answers in one pass. Answers are evaluated in both multiple-choice and free-form formats, using exact match for structured predictions and an LLM judge for free-form responses. By explicitly separating visual-source identification from answer correctness, the benchmark exposes grounding failures that answer-only evaluation misses.

摘要（中文）：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉推理基准测试中取得了显著成果，但仅凭答案准确率无法判断模型是否依赖了正确的视觉证据。这一缺陷在用于自动驾驶的多视角驾驶场景中尤为突出——模型可能给出看似合理的答案，却将推理依据错误地关联到其他摄像头视角。我们提出了一种用于评估证据来源识别能力的多视角视觉问答基准：给定六个同步的NuScenes视角画面及一个问题，模型必须确定支持答案的摄像头视角并回答问题。该基准包含来自73个场景的122个以冲突为核心的问答对，涵盖因果推理、反事实推理和意图预测。视角标签由自动化冲突挖掘流程生成，并经标注人员人工验证。我们评估了三种设置：摄像头视角选择、基于黄金视角的预言式问答，以及模型一次性选择视角并回答问题的联合预测。答案以多选题和自由格式两种形式进行评估，结构化预测采用精确匹配，自由格式回答则由大语言模型裁判评判。通过将视觉来源识别与答案正确性明确分离，该基准揭示了仅评估答案时难以发现的推理依据错误。

Authors: Yimu Wang, Yee Man Choi, Barry Zhang, Mozhgan Nasr Azadani, Sean Sedwards, Krzysztof Czarnecki

Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model WorldModel

multi-agent video world model camera-controllable cross-view consistency geometry-aware denoising minimap guidance

简要说明：Prisma-World 是一个相机可控的多智能体视频世界模型，通过将多智能体生成视为联合几何感知去噪过程来生成一致的多视图视频，并引入大规模 UE5 数据集用于训练和评估。

TLDR: Prisma-World is a camera-controllable multi-agent video world model that generates consistent multi-view videos by treating multi-agent generation as a joint geometry-aware denoising process, and it introduces a large-scale UE5 dataset for training and evaluation.

Abstract: Video world models have made rapid progress in generating controllable visual experiences, but most of them still simulate the world from a single observer. Extending such models to multiple agents raises a central challenge: if each agent's future state is generated independently, overlapping views may instantiate different versions of the same scene, leading to inconsistent objects, layouts, and appearances across agents. Conventional camera conditioning controls individual trajectories, but it does not explicitly couple the generation of views that should agree under shared scene geometry. We introduce Prisma-World, a camera-controllable multi-agent world model that formulates multi-agent generation as a joint geometry-aware denoising process for cross-view consistency. Prisma-World processes all agent videos within one full-attention sequence, uses a multi-agent RoPE design to distinguish agent identities while preserving synchronized temporal coordinates, and injects relative camera geometry into attention to bias overlapping viewpoints toward shared scene evidence. To further strengthen multi-view consistency and enhance global spatial perception, we augment our framework with an overlap-decaying curriculum training paradigm alongside minimap-conditioned structural guidance. To facilitate the training and evaluation of multi-agent models, we introduce PrismaDataset, a large-scale UE5 dataset with panoramic acquisition across diverse scenes, composable multi-agent view groups with flexible agent counts and complex camera trajectories, and precise camera/action annotations for consistency training and evaluation. Experiments show that a single Prisma-World model can generate high-fidelity multi-agent videos with flexible agent numbers, camera controllability, improved cross-view consistency, and spatial grounding under minimap guidance.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型在生成可控视觉体验方面取得了快速进展，但大多数模型仍以单一观察者视角模拟世界。将此类模型扩展至多智能体面临核心挑战：若各智能体未来状态独立生成，重叠视角可能实例化同一场景的不同版本，导致智能体间物体、布局及外观不一致。传统相机条件控制可调控个体轨迹，但无法显式耦合在共享场景几何下应达成一致的视角生成过程。我们提出Prisma-World——一种相机可控的多智能体世界模型，将多智能体生成建模为面向跨视角一致性的联合几何感知去噪过程。Prisma-World在统一的全局注意力序列中处理所有智能体视频，采用多智能体RoPE设计在保持同步时间坐标的同时区分智能体身份，并将相对相机几何注入注意力机制，使重叠视角偏向共享场景证据。为增强多视角一致性并提升全局空间感知，我们引入重叠衰减课程训练范式及小地图条件结构引导。为促进多智能体模型的训练与评估，我们提出PrismaDataset——包含跨多样场景全景采集的大规模UE5数据集、可组合的多智能体视角组（支持灵活智能体数量与复杂相机轨迹），以及用于一致性训练与评估的精确相机/动作标注。实验表明，单个Prisma-World模型可生成高保真多智能体视频，支持灵活智能体数量、相机可控性、改进的跨视角一致性及小地图引导下的空间定位。

Authors: Huiqiang Sun, Zhan Peng, Size Wu, Kun Wang, Kang Liao, Dianyi Wang, Xingyu Zeng, Sheng Jin, Yangguang Li, Zhiguo Cao, Ziwei Liu, Wei Li

Zero-Shot Semantic Re-Identification for Autonomous Driving: A VLM Baseline Study AutonomousDriving

zero-shot re-identification vision-language models semantic attribute description autonomous driving interpretable matching

简要说明：本文提出了一种使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）为零样本生成结构化语义属性描述的方法，用于自动驾驶中跨视角的车辆、行人和骑车人重识别，性能与监督CNN基线相当，且具有更好的可解释性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a zero-shot pipeline using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate structured semantic attribute descriptions for re-identifying vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists across views in autonomous driving, achieving comparable performance to supervised CNN baselines with improved interpretability.

Abstract: Re-Identification (ReID) in autonomous driving is typically formulated as a visual matching problem, where observations of vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists are associated across time, frames, or camera views using learned appearance embeddings, often complemented by motion, geometric, or multimodal cues. However, purely visual representations may be sensitive to viewpoint, occlusion, illumination, and sensor-domain variations, limiting their interpretability and robustness in complex driving scenes. We propose a baseline study of a zero-shot pipeline using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate textual descriptions of detected traffic participants and evaluate whether these descriptions can support identity matching across observations. Instead of relying only on low-level visual similarity, the proposed formulation represents each object through structured semantic attributes, including category, color, shape, pose, visible parts, spatial context, and distinctive visual cues. This study provides an initial benchmark for language-based re-identification in autonomous-driving scenarios, discussing and evaluating the strengths and limitations of current VLMs for this task. Results demonstrate that zero-shot semantic descriptions can support effective object re-identification, achieving retrieval performance comparable to a supervised CNN baseline while offering greater interpretability through explicit identity cues. However, the experiments also reveal important challenges, including attribute inconsistency across viewpoints and limited fine-grained discrimination between visually similar instances.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 自动驾驶中的再识别（ReID）通常被建模为视觉匹配问题，即通过学习的外观嵌入（常辅以运动、几何或多模态线索），将车辆、行人及骑行者的观测结果在时间、帧间或不同相机视角下进行关联。然而，纯视觉表征可能对视角、遮挡、光照及传感器域差异敏感，从而限制了其在复杂驾驶场景中的可解释性与鲁棒性。我们提出一项基线研究，基于零样本流水线，利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）生成检测到的交通参与者的文本描述，并评估这些描述能否支撑跨观测的身份匹配。该方案不依赖底层视觉相似性，而是通过结构化语义属性（包括类别、颜色、形状、姿态、可见部件、空间上下文及显著视觉线索）来表征每个物体。本研究为自动驾驶场景中基于语言的再识别提供了初步基准，讨论并评估了当前VLM在此任务中的优势与局限。结果表明，零样本语义描述能够支持有效的物体再识别，在检索性能上接近有监督CNN基线，并通过显式身份线索提供了更强的可解释性。然而，实验也揭示了重要挑战，包括跨视角的属性不一致性，以及对视觉相似实例的细粒度区分能力有限。

EditSSC: Toward Editable Semantic Occupancy Scenes with Unconditional Diffusion Models AutonomousDriving

3D semantic scene generation Bird's Eye View (BEV) latent diffusion editing autonomous driving

简要说明：EditSSC 利用 BEV 表示和 Stable Diffusion 的潜在扩散模型实现可编辑的 3D 语义占用场景生成，支持无需重训练的草图引导编辑、内补和外补。

TLDR: EditSSC repurposes 2D latent diffusion models (Stable Diffusion) with BEV representations for editable 3D semantic occupancy scene generation in autonomous driving, enabling training-free sketch-guided editing, inpainting, and outpainting.

Abstract: 3D semantic scene generation is crucial for autonomous driving applications, yet most methods rely on complex 3D-specific architectures such as triplane encoders and adapted diffusion networks, limiting both their simplicity and their editing capabilities. We propose EditSSC, an editing-ready method for 3D semantic scene generation using 2D Bird's Eye View (BEV) representations and off-the-shelf latent diffusion network. Our approach reshapes 3D semantic occupancy grids into multi-channel BEV images and leverages the quantized autoencoder and UNet from Stable Diffusion with minimal modifications. We perform diffusion on the latents after quantization, which enables training-free editing capabilities. By exploiting class-to-code correspondences in the codebook, our method supports sketch-guided generation, inpainting, and outpainting without any retraining. On SemanticKITTI, EditSSC outperforms existing 3D-specific baselines on unconditional generation, demonstrating that well-established 2D architectures can be effectively repurposed for 3D scene generation and editing.

摘要（中文）：3D语义场景生成对自动驾驶应用至关重要，但现有方法大多依赖复杂的三维专用架构（如三平面编码器和适配扩散网络），这限制了其简洁性与编辑能力。我们提出EditSSC——一种基于二维鸟瞰图（BEV）表示与现成潜在扩散网络的3D语义场景可编辑生成方法。本方法将3D语义占用网格重塑为多通道BEV图像，并通过最小化改造利用Stable Diffusion的量化自编码器与UNet。我们在量化后的潜在空间执行扩散，由此实现无需训练的编辑能力。通过利用码本中类别与编码的对应关系，本方法支持无需重新训练的草图引导生成、补全与外推。在SemanticKITTI数据集上，EditSSC在无条件生成任务中超越了现有三维专用基线模型，证明成熟的二维架构可被有效迁移至3D场景生成与编辑任务。

Authors: Fatima Balde, Raoul de Charette, Alexandre Boulch

Safe Polytope-in-Polytope Motion Planning and Control with Control Barrier Functions Other

control barrier functions model predictive control polytopic robot footprint free-space region motion planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种安全局部运动规划与控制方法，利用离散时间控制屏障函数保证多面体机器人足迹始终位于凸自由空间区域内，实现了狭窄环境中的实时安全导航。

TLDR: This paper proposes a safe local motion planning and control method that guarantees a polytopic robot footprint stays inside a convex free-space region using discrete-time control barrier functions, achieving real-time safe navigation in tight environments.

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots operating in tight environments require motion planning frameworks that account for the physical footprint of the robot. Simplifying the geometry to a point or a circle is conservative and discards information needed to successfully and safely traverse narrow passages. This work proposes a safe local motion planning and control method that guarantees that a polytopic robot footprint stays inside a continuously updated convex free-space region. The containment condition is formulated as a set of discrete-time control barrier function constraints within a model predictive controller. The number of safety constraints depends on the complexity of the local free-space geometry and the robot shape, instead of the number of obstacles. The proposed free-space formulation does not need any obstacle detection or segmentation. A comparative analysis against a polytope-based obstacle avoidance formulation confirms favorable scaling up to a reduction of 91$\times$ in computation time as the number of obstacles increases. The approach is validated in simulation with an autonomous surface vehicle and on hardware with a non-holonomic mobile robot, using both occupancy grids and LiDAR sensing. The experiments demonstrate safe real-time motion planning and control at 10~Hz on an onboard embedded computer, including reactive avoidance of dynamic obstacles.

摘要（中文）：自治移动机器人在狭窄环境中运行时，其运动规划框架需要考虑机器人的实际占地面积。将几何体简化为一个点或圆形虽然保守，但会丢弃成功安全穿越狭窄通道所需的信息。本文提出一种安全的局部运动规划与控制方法，确保多面体机器人占地面积始终保持在持续更新的凸自由空间区域内。该包含条件被表述为模型预测控制器中的一组离散时间控制障碍函数约束。安全约束的数量取决于局部自由空间几何复杂度及机器人形状，而非障碍物数量。所提出的自由空间公式无需任何障碍物检测或分割。与基于多面体的避障公式对比分析表明，随着障碍物数量增加，计算时间可缩减高达91倍。该方法通过自主水面车辆仿真验证，并在非完整移动机器人硬件平台中结合占用网格与激光雷达传感进行实验。实验表明，在机载嵌入式计算机上可实现10Hz频率的安全实时运动规划与控制，包含对动态障碍物的反应式避让。

Authors: Alejandro Gonzalez-Garcia, Dries Dirckx, Jan Swevers, Wilm Decré

Physics-Aware Sparse Learning and Selective Online Adaptation for Euler-Lagrange Robot Dynamics RLRobot

structure-preserving residual learning Euler-Lagrange dynamics online Bayesian linear regression latent interaction model model-based control

简要说明：提出一种保结构残差学习框架，将欧拉-拉格朗日机器人动力学模型误差分解为受物理约束的惯性/科里奥利项和可在线稀疏适应的广义力残差，在移动、空中和操作平台上提升了动力学预测与轨迹跟踪性能。

TLDR: A structure-preserving residual learning framework for Euler-Lagrange robot dynamics that separates model mismatch into physically constrained inertia/Coriolis corrections and a sparse, online-adapted generalized-force residual, improving prediction and tracking on mobile, aerial, and manipulator platforms.

Abstract: Accurate dynamics models are essential for model-based robotic control, yet nominal Euler--Lagrange models often become inaccurate in the presence of payload variation, unmodeled coupling, friction, aerodynamic effects, and changing operating conditions. Most learning-based correction methods improve prediction accuracy by introducing a single additive residual, but do not preserve the internal mechanical structure of Euler--Lagrange systems. This leads to models that do not preserve symmetry, positive-definiteness, or the coupling between inertia and velocity-dependent terms, which can result in physically inconsistent predictions and reduced reliability when embedded in model-based controllers. We propose a structure-preserving residual learning framework that decomposes model mismatch into an inertia correction, the corresponding induced Coriolis term, and a generalized-force residual. The mechanical component is learned under physical constraints, while the disturbance-sensitive component is represented through a sparse history-dependent latent interaction model and adapted online using Bayesian linear regression. This separation preserves key mechanical structure while restricting adaptation to the part of the dynamics most affected by changing conditions. Experiments across multiple robotic platforms, including mobile, aerial, and manipulator systems, show that the proposed method improves dynamics prediction and trajectory tracking under coupled and time-varying dynamics. These results highlight the value of combining structured residual modeling, compact latent interaction selection, and selective online adaptation for real-world model-based control.

摘要（中文）：准确的动力学模型对于基于模型的机器人控制至关重要，然而，标称的欧拉—拉格朗日模型在存在负载变化、未建模耦合、摩擦、空气动力学效应以及运行条件变化时往往会变得不准确。大多数基于学习的修正方法通过引入单一的加性残差来提高预测精度，但未能保留欧拉—拉格朗日系统的内部力学结构。这导致模型无法保持对称性、正定性，或者惯性与速度相关项之间的耦合，当嵌入基于模型的控制器时，可能产生物理上不一致的预测并降低可靠性。我们提出了一种保持结构的残差学习框架，将模型失配分解为惯性修正、相应的诱导科里奥利项以及广义力残差。力学部分在物理约束下进行学习，而扰动敏感部分则通过一个稀疏的、依赖历史状态的潜在交互模型来表示，并利用贝叶斯线性回归实现在线自适应。这种分解保留了关键的力学结构，同时将自适应限制在受变化条件影响最大的动力学部分。在包括移动机器人、空中机器人和机械臂系统在内的多个机器人平台上的实验表明，所提出的方法在耦合和时变动力学条件下，改善了动力学预测和轨迹跟踪性能。这些结果凸显了将结构化残差建模、紧凑的潜在交互选择以及选择性在线自适应相结合，对于实际的基于模型控制的价值。

Authors: Rishabh Dev Yadav, Samaksh Ujjawal, Sihao Sun, Spandan Roy, Wei Pan

EPS3D: End-to-End Feed-Forward 3D Panoptic Segmentation Perception3D

end-to-end 3D panoptic segmentation open-vocabulary distillation mutual enhancement

简要说明：EPS3D 是一个端到端的前馈框架，用于从多视图图像进行开放词汇 3D 全景分割，通过蒸馏和相互增强策略在基准测试中达到最优性能，并支持机器人操作等下游任务。

TLDR: EPS3D is an end-to-end feed-forward framework for open-vocabulary 3D panoptic segmentation from multi-view images, using distillation and mutual enhancement to achieve state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and support downstream robotics tasks.

Abstract: This paper introduces EPS3D, a new end-to-end feed-forward framework for open-vocabulary 3D panoptic segmentation. Unlike existing methods relying on additional preprocessing, we design an end-to-end architecture, with a distillation-based training strategy on diverse 3D scenes to predict 3D-aware semantic and instance features from multi-view images, improving 3D consistency and avoiding error accumulation. We further propose a mutual enhancement module to enforce inherent semantic-instance consistency. By aligning semantics within instances (Ins2Sem) and refining instance features with semantic guidance (Sem2Ins), we achieve more coherent 3D scene understanding. Ultimately, EPS3D outperforms SOTA baselines on two benchmarks (e.g., +13% mIoU for semantics on Replica) with high efficiency (e.g., 1s per scene), supporting tasks like robotic manipulation and 3D scene editing.

摘要（中文）：本文提出EPS3D，一种用于开放词汇三维全景分割的新型端到端前馈框架。与依赖额外预处理的现有方法不同，我们设计了一种端到端架构，结合基于蒸馏的训练策略，在多种三维场景中从多视角图像预测具有三维感知的语义特征与实例特征，从而提升三维一致性并避免误差累积。我们进一步提出一种相互增强模块，以强化内在的语义-实例一致性。通过实现实例内语义对齐（Ins2Sem）与语义引导下的实例特征优化（Sem2Ins），我们获得了更连贯的三维场景理解能力。最终，EPS3D在两个基准测试中均超越现有最优基线（例如，在Replica数据集上语义mIoU提升13%），且具备高效率（例如，每场景处理时间1秒），可支持机器人操作与三维场景编辑等任务。
